11.1 Content Integrity & Security



```go

package security



type ContentSecurityService struct {

    contentSigner ContentSigner

    watermarkService WatermarkService

    promptProtector PromptProtector

    rateLimiter   RateLimiter

}



// ContentSigner cryptographically signs all generated content

type ContentSigner struct {

    signingKey ed25519.PrivateKey

}



func (cs *ContentSigner) SignContent(content *GeneratedContent) (*SignedContent, error) {

    // Create canonical representation for signing

    canonical := cs.canonicalize(content)



    // Hash

    hash := sha256.Sum256(canonical)
    // Sign

    signature := ed25519.Sign(cs.signingKey, hash[:])



    return &SignedContent{

       Content:     content,

       ContentHash: hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]),

       Signature: hex.EncodeToString(signature),

       SignedAt: time.Now(),

       SignerID: "content-factory-v1",

    }, nil

}



// PromptProtector prevents prompt injection and data leakage

type PromptProtector struct{}



func (pp *PromptProtector) SanitizePromptInput(input string) (string, error) {

    // Remove prompt injection patterns

    injectionPatterns := []string{

       "ignore previous instructions",

       "ignore all previous",

       "system prompt:",

       "<<SYS>>",

       "you are now",

       "new instructions:",

       "override:",
    }



    sanitized := input

    for _, pattern := range injectionPatterns {

        if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(sanitized), pattern) {

            return "", ErrPromptInjectionDetected

        }

    }



    return sanitized, nil

}



// WatermarkService embeds invisible watermarks for content tracking

type WatermarkService struct{}



func (ws *WatermarkService) EmbedWatermark(

    content string,

    metadata WatermarkMetadata,

) (string, error) {

    // Embed zero-width characters for text watermarking

    watermark := ws.encodeWatermark(metadata)



    // Insert watermark at strategic positions

    watermarked := ws.insertWatermark(content, watermark)



    return watermarked, nil
}

ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORDS (ADR)



ADR-CMP-001: Pre-Publication Compliance Gateway



Decision: All content must pass through the Compliance Gatekeeper as a synchronous gateway
before any distribution occurs. No content reaches any platform without explicit compliance
clearance.

Rationale: Legal and regulatory risks of AI-generated content require a hard gateway, not an
advisory service. Post-publication corrections are reputationally damaging and legally
insufficient.
Alternatives Considered: Asynchronous advisory compliance (rejected — too risky for
automated publishing at scale).



ADR-CMP-002: Tiered Risk Classification with Automated Triage



Decision: Implement a four-tier risk classification system (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL) with
automated handling for LOW/MEDIUM and mandatory human review for HIGH/CRITICAL.

Rationale: 85% of content is expected to be LOW/MEDIUM risk. Full human review of all
content is not scalable. Risk-based routing optimizes human reviewer utilization.

Alternatives Considered: Human review for all content (rejected — not scalable); fully
automated for all (rejected — too risky).



ADR-CMP-003: Independent Compliance Scoring Engine



Decision: Compliance scores are calculated by an independent engine that aggregates multiple
specialized checkers, with no single checker having veto power except for CRITICAL findings.

Rationale: Prevents any single compliance dimension from unnecessarily blocking publication
while ensuring CRITICAL issues always stop distribution.

Alternatives Considered: Sequential gating (rejected — creates bottlenecks); simple AND-gating
(rejected — too restrictive).



ADR-CMP-004: Immutable Compliance Audit Trail



Decision: Every compliance decision, including automated approvals, must be recorded in an
immutable, cryptographically-chained audit log with complete provenance.

Rationale: Regulatory compliance and legal defensibility require incontrovertible evidence of
compliance review for every published piece of content.

Consequences: Additional storage and write latency, but essential for legal protection.

1.1 Purpose, Scope & Responsibilities



Purpose: The Compliance Gatekeeper is the final safeguard before any AI-generated content
reaches an audience. It ensures every piece of content is legally safe, copyright compliant,
privacy-respecting, and ethically sound before publication.



Core Responsibilities:



Responsibility Description Criticality

Copyright Protection Detect and prevent copyright infringement CRITICAL

AI Safety Detect hallucinations, fabricated content, unsupported claims CRITICAL

Platform Compliance Ensure content meets each platform's policies HIGH

Editorial Authorization Route high-risk content for human review HIGH

Audit & Traceability Maintain complete compliance decision records CRITICAL

1.4 Enterprise Principles



1. Safety Before Speed: Compliance must never be sacrificed for publication speed

2. Defense in Depth: Multiple independent checks, no single point of failure

3. Presumption of Review: When uncertain, route to human review

4. Complete Auditability: Every decision must be explainable and traceable

5. Privacy by Design: PII protection is proactive, not reactive

6. Jurisdictional Awareness: Compliance rules adapt to geographic and regulatory context

7. Continuous Learning: Feedback from human reviewers improves automated checks

2.3 Copyright Detection



```go

type CopyrightChecker struct {

      fingerprintDB FingerprintDatabase

      externalAPIs    []CopyrightAPI

      similarityEngine SimilarityEngine
}



type CopyrightAPI interface {

  CheckContent(ctx context.Context, content []byte, contentType string)
(*ExternalCopyrightResult, error)

    Name() string

}



type TextCopyrightResult struct {

    OriginalityScore float64              `json:"originality_score"` // 0-100

    MatchedSources         []MatchedSource         `json:"matched_sources"`

    FairUseAssessment *FairUseAssessment             `json:"fair_use_assessment"`

    RiskLevel         RiskLevel         `json:"risk_level"`

}



type MatchedSource struct {

    SourceURL         string `json:"source_url"`

    MatchPercentage float64 `json:"match_percentage"`

    MatchType         string `json:"match_type"`      // EXACT, PARAPHRASE, STRUCTURAL

    SourceLicense string `json:"source_license"`

    RequiresAttribution bool `json:"requires_attribution"`

}



func (cc *CopyrightChecker) CheckTextCopyright(

    ctx context.Context,

    content string,
  metadata ContentMetadata,

) (*TextCopyrightResult, error) {



  result := &TextCopyrightResult{}



  // 1. Generate content fingerprint

  fingerprint := cc.generateFingerprint(content)



  // 2. Check against internal fingerprint database

  internalMatches, err := cc.fingerprintDB.FindMatches(ctx, fingerprint, 0.85)

  if err != nil {

      return nil, fmt.Errorf("internal fingerprint check: %w", err)

  }



  // 3. Check against external copyright APIs

  var externalMatches []MatchedSource

  for _, api := range cc.externalAPIs {

      extResult, err := api.CheckContent(ctx, []byte(content), "text/plain")

      if err != nil {

          // Log but continue with other APIs

          log.Warn().Err(err).Str("api", api.Name()).Msg("External copyright API failed")

          continue

      }

      externalMatches = append(externalMatches, extResult.Matches...)

  }
    // 4. Merge and deduplicate matches

    allMatches := cc.mergeMatches(internalMatches, externalMatches)

    result.MatchedSources = allMatches



    // 5. Calculate originality score

    result.OriginalityScore = cc.calculateOriginality(content, allMatches)



    // 6. Assess fair use if matches found

    if len(allMatches) > 0 {

        result.FairUseAssessment = cc.fairUseAssessor.Assess(content, allMatches, metadata)

    }



    // 7. Determine risk level

    result.RiskLevel = cc.determineRisk(result)



    return result, nil

}



func (cc *CopyrightChecker) calculateOriginality(

    content string,

    matches []MatchedSource,

) float64 {

    if len(matches) == 0 {

        return 100.0

    }
      // Weight by match percentage and source type

      totalDeduction := 0.0



      for _, match := range matches {

          deduction := match.MatchPercentage



          // Exact matches are more severe

          if match.MatchType == "EXACT" {

              deduction *= 1.5

          }



          // Structural matches are less severe

          if match.MatchType == "STRUCTURAL" {

              deduction *= 0.5

          }



          totalDeduction += deduction

      }



      originality := 100.0 - math.Min(totalDeduction, 100.0)

      return math.Max(0, originality)

}

```



2.4 Fair Use Assessment
```go

type FairUseAssessor struct {

    legalKnowledgeBase LegalKnowledgeBase

}



type FairUseAssessment struct {

    IsFairUse         bool            `json:"is_fair_use"`

    Confidence         float64           `json:"confidence"`      // 0-1

    Factors          []FairUseFactor      `json:"factors"`

    Recommendation           string         `json:"recommendation"`

    RequiresHumanReview bool                   `json:"requires_human_review"`

}



type FairUseFactor struct {

    Factor      string `json:"factor"`     // PURPOSE, NATURE, AMOUNT, EFFECT

    Weight       float64 `json:"weight"`      // How heavily this factor weighs

    Score       float64 `json:"score"`      // -1 to 1 (-1 = against fair use, 1 = supports)

    Analysis string `json:"analysis"`

}



func (fa *FairUseAssessor) Assess(

    content string,

    matches []MatchedSource,

    metadata ContentMetadata,

) *FairUseAssessment {
assessment := &FairUseAssessment{

    Factors: []FairUseFactor{

         fa.assessPurposeAndCharacter(content, metadata),

         fa.assessNatureOfCopyrightedWork(matches),

         fa.assessAmountAndSubstantiality(content, matches),

         fa.assessEffectOnMarket(matches, metadata),

    },

}



// Calculate overall score

totalScore := 0.0

totalWeight := 0.0



for _, factor := range assessment.Factors {

    totalScore += factor.Score * factor.Weight

    totalWeight += factor.Weight

}



overallScore := totalScore / totalWeight



// Determine fair use

assessment.IsFairUse = overallScore > 0.3

assessment.Confidence = math.Abs(overallScore)

assessment.RequiresHumanReview = math.Abs(overallScore) < 0.5



// Generate recommendation
    if assessment.IsFairUse && assessment.Confidence > 0.7 {

        assessment.Recommendation = "LIKELY_FAIR_USE_CAN_PROCEED"

    } else if assessment.IsFairUse {

        assessment.Recommendation = "POSSIBLE_FAIR_USE_HUMAN_REVIEW_RECOMMENDED"

    } else if assessment.Confidence > 0.7 {

        assessment.Recommendation = "UNLIKELY_FAIR_USE_SEEK_PERMISSION"

    } else {

        assessment.Recommendation = "UNCERTAIN_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED"

    }



    return assessment

}



func (fa *FairUseAssessor) assessPurposeAndCharacter(

    content string,

    metadata ContentMetadata,

) FairUseFactor {

    factor := FairUseFactor{

        Factor: "PURPOSE_AND_CHARACTER",

        Weight: 0.30,

    }



    score := 0.0

    analyses := []string{}



    // News reporting favors fair use
if metadata.ContentType == "NEWS" {

    score += 0.5

    analyses = append(analyses, "News reporting purpose supports fair use")

}



// Transformative use favors fair use

if metadata.IsTransformative {

    score += 0.3

    analyses = append(analyses, "Content is transformative")

}



// Commercial use weighs against fair use

if metadata.IsCommercial {

    score -= 0.3

    analyses = append(analyses, "Commercial use weighs against fair use")

}



// Educational use favors fair use

if metadata.IsEducational {

    score += 0.4

    analyses = append(analyses, "Educational purpose supports fair use")

}



factor.Score = math.Max(-1, math.Min(1, score))

factor.Analysis = strings.Join(analyses, "; ")
    return factor

}



func (fa *FairUseAssessor) assessAmountAndSubstantiality(

    content string,

    matches []MatchedSource,

) FairUseFactor {

    factor := FairUseFactor{

        Factor: "AMOUNT_AND_SUBSTANTIALITY",

        Weight: 0.25,

    }



    score := 0.0

    analyses := []string{}



    // Calculate percentage of content that is matched

    for _, match := range matches {

        if match.MatchPercentage < 10 {

          score += 0.3

          analyses = append(analyses, "Small portion used")

        } else if match.MatchPercentage < 30 {

          score += 0.1

          analyses = append(analyses, "Moderate portion used")

        } else {

          score -= 0.3

          analyses = append(analyses, "Substantial portion used")
          }



          // Check if the matched portion is the "heart" of the work

          if match.IsCoreContent {

              score -= 0.4

              analyses = append(analyses, "Core/heart of the work was used")

          }

      }



      factor.Score = math.Max(-1, math.Min(1, score))

      factor.Analysis = strings.Join(analyses, "; ")



      return factor

}

```



2.5 License Management

type LicenseInfo struct {

      LicenseType       LicenseType       `json:"license_type"`
    AssetID       string        `json:"asset_id"`

    ValidFrom      time.Time          `json:"valid_from"`

    ValidUntil    *time.Time          `json:"valid_until"`

    TerritoryRestrictions []string      `json:"territory_restrictions"`

    UsageLimits     UsageLimits         `json:"usage_limits"`

    AttributionText string           `json:"attribution_text"`

    Cost         *LicenseCost        `json:"cost"`

    RenewalPolicy RenewalPolicy            `json:"renewal_policy"`

}



type LicenseType string

const (

    LicensePublicDomain LicenseType = "PUBLIC_DOMAIN"

    LicenseCreativeCommons LicenseType = "CREATIVE_COMMONS"

    LicenseCommercial        LicenseType = "COMMERCIAL"

    LicenseEditorial       LicenseType = "EDITORIAL"

    LicenseAIGenerated       LicenseType = "AI_GENERATED"

    LicenseStaffCreated LicenseType = "STAFF_CREATED"

    LicenseUnknown           LicenseType = "UNKNOWN"

)



type UsageLimits struct {

    MaxImpressions *int64         `json:"max_impressions"`

    MaxPublications *int        `json:"max_publications"`

    AllowedPlatforms []string `json:"allowed_platforms"`

    AllowedFormats []string `json:"allowed_formats"`
    ModificationAllowed bool        `json:"modification_allowed"`

}



func (lv *LicenseValidator) ValidateLicense(

    ctx context.Context,

    assetID string,

    usage UsageContext,

) (*LicenseValidationResult, error) {



    // Get license

    license, err := lv.licenseDB.GetLicense(ctx, assetID)

    if err != nil {

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("get license: %w", err)

    }



    result := &LicenseValidationResult{

        AssetID: assetID,

        License: license,

        IsValid: true,

    }



    // Check expiration

    if license.ValidUntil != nil && time.Now().After(*license.ValidUntil) {

        result.IsValid = false

        result.Issues = append(result.Issues, LicenseIssue{

          Type:       "EXPIRED",
         Severity: "CRITICAL",

         Message: fmt.Sprintf("License expired on %s", license.ValidUntil.Format("2006-01-02")),

    })

}



// Check territory restrictions

if len(license.TerritoryRestrictions) > 0 {

    if !contains(license.TerritoryRestrictions, usage.TargetTerritory) {

         result.IsValid = false

         result.Issues = append(result.Issues, LicenseIssue{

              Type:   "TERRITORY_RESTRICTION",

              Severity: "HIGH",

              Message: fmt.Sprintf("License not valid in %s", usage.TargetTerritory),

         })

    }

}



// Check usage limits

if license.UsageLimits.MaxPublications != nil {

    currentUsage, _ := lv.licenseDB.GetUsageCount(ctx, assetID)

    if currentUsage >= *license.UsageLimits.MaxPublications {

         result.IsValid = false

         result.Issues = append(result.Issues, LicenseIssue{

              Type:   "USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",

              Severity: "HIGH",

              Message: "Maximum publication limit reached",
         })

    }

}



// Check platform restrictions

if len(license.UsageLimits.AllowedPlatforms) > 0 {

    if !contains(license.UsageLimits.AllowedPlatforms, usage.TargetPlatform) {

         result.IsValid = false

         result.Issues = append(result.Issues, LicenseIssue{

              Type:    "PLATFORM_RESTRICTION",

              Severity: "MEDIUM",

              Message: fmt.Sprintf("License not valid for platform: %s", usage.TargetPlatform),

         })

    }

}



// Check modification rights

if usage.IsModified && !license.UsageLimits.ModificationAllowed {

    result.IsValid = false

    result.Issues = append(result.Issues, LicenseIssue{

         Type:        "MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED",

         Severity: "HIGH",

         Message: "License does not permit modifications",

    })

}
      // Check attribution requirements

      if license.AttributionText != "" && !usage.IncludesAttribution {

          result.RequiresAttribution = true

          result.RequiredAttribution = license.AttributionText

          result.Issues = append(result.Issues, LicenseIssue{

               Type:   "ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRED",

               Severity: "MEDIUM",

               Message: "Attribution required but not present",

          })

      }



      return result, nil

}

3.1 Plagiarism Detection Engine



```python

class PlagiarismDetectionService:

  """

  Multi-strategy plagiarism detection for AI-generated content.

  """



  def __init__(self):

    self.semantic_matcher = SemanticSimilarityMatcher()

    self.sentence_matcher = SentenceLevelMatcher()

    self.cross_lingual = CrossLingualPlagiarismDetector()

    self.ai_plagiarism = AIGeneratedPlagiarismDetector()

    self.internal_duplicate = InternalDuplicateDetector()

    self.citation_validator = CitationValidator()



  async def detect_plagiarism(

    self,

    content: str,

    metadata: ContentMetadata,

    locked_facts: LockedFactSet,
) -> PlagiarismReport:

  """

  Comprehensive plagiarism detection.

  """



  # Run all detection strategies in parallel

  tasks = [

      self.semantic_matcher.check(content, metadata),

      self.sentence_matcher.check(content, metadata),

      self.cross_lingual.check(content, metadata),

      self.ai_plagiarism.check(content, metadata, locked_facts),

      self.internal_duplicate.check(content, metadata),

  ]



  results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)



  report = PlagiarismReport(

      content_id=metadata.content_id,

      checked_at=datetime.utcnow(),

  )



  # Aggregate results

  all_matches = []

  for i, result in enumerate(results):

      if isinstance(result, Exception):

        report.add_error(f"Strategy {i} failed: {result}")
          continue

    all_matches.extend(result.matches)



  # Deduplicate matches

  report.matches = self.deduplicate_matches(all_matches)



  # Calculate overall scores

  report.originality_score = self.calculate_originality(content, report.matches)

  report.plagiarism_risk = self.calculate_risk(report)



  # Generate recommendations

  report.recommended_actions = self.generate_actions(report)



  return report



async def check_semantic_similarity(

  self,

  content: str,

  metadata: ContentMetadata,

) -> SimilarityResult:

  """

  Check for semantic similarity with known content.

  """



  # Generate embedding

  embedding = await self.generate_embedding(content)
# Search vector database

similar = await self.vector_db.search(

    embedding=embedding,

    threshold=0.85, # High similarity threshold

    top_k=20,

    filters={

        "exclude_self": metadata.content_id,

        "date_range": "last_90_days",

    }

)



matches = []

for match in similar:

    if match.similarity > 0.90:

        severity = "HIGH"

    elif match.similarity > 0.85:

        severity = "MEDIUM"

    else:

        severity = "LOW"



    matches.append(PlagiarismMatch(

        source_url=match.url,

        source_title=match.title,

        similarity_score=match.similarity,

        match_type="SEMANTIC",
          severity=severity,

          matched_excerpt=match.excerpt,

    ))



  return SimilarityResult(matches=matches)



async def check_sentence_level(

  self,

  content: str,

  metadata: ContentMetadata,

) -> SimilarityResult:

  """

  Check for exact or near-exact sentence matches.

  """



  sentences = self.segment_sentences(content)

  matches = []



  for sentence in sentences:

    if len(sentence.split()) < 5:

          continue # Skip very short sentences



    # Search for exact and fuzzy matches

    exact_matches = await self.search_exact_matches(sentence)

    fuzzy_matches = await self.search_fuzzy_matches(sentence, threshold=0.90)
        for match in exact_matches:

          matches.append(PlagiarismMatch(

               source_url=match.url,

               similarity_score=1.0,

               match_type="EXACT_SENTENCE",

               severity="CRITICAL",

               matched_excerpt=sentence,

          ))



        for match in fuzzy_matches:

          severity = "HIGH" if match.similarity > 0.95 else "MEDIUM"

          matches.append(PlagiarismMatch(

               source_url=match.url,

               similarity_score=match.similarity,

               match_type="NEAR_EXACT_SENTENCE",

               severity=severity,

               matched_excerpt=sentence,

          ))



      return SimilarityResult(matches=matches)

```



3.2 AI-Generated Plagiarism Detection



```python

class AIGeneratedPlagiarismDetector:
"""

Specialized detection for AI-generated content that may memorize training data.

"""



def __init__(self):

  self.memorization_detector = MemorizationDetector()

  self.training_data_checker = TrainingDataChecker()



async def check(

  self,

  content: str,

  metadata: ContentMetadata,

  locked_facts: LockedFactSet,

) -> SimilarityResult:

  """

  Check if AI-generated content contains memorized training data.

  """



  matches = []



  # 1. Check for verbatim memorization patterns

  memorized = await self.memorization_detector.detect(content)

  for mem in memorized:

      matches.append(PlagiarismMatch(

          source_url="AI_TRAINING_DATA",

          similarity_score=mem.confidence,
               match_type="AI_MEMORIZATION",

               severity="CRITICAL",

               matched_excerpt=mem.text,

               metadata={"model": mem.likely_model},

          ))



        # 2. Check if content is too similar to known training sources

        training_matches = await self.training_data_checker.check(content)

        matches.extend(training_matches)



        # 3. Verify all quotes and facts are from locked fact set

        # (This catches AI fabricating quotes that happen to match real ones)

        for match in matches:

          if not self.is_in_locked_facts(match.matched_excerpt, locked_facts):

               match.severity = "CRITICAL"

               match.match_type = "AI_MEMORIZATION_UNVERIFIED"



        return SimilarityResult(matches=matches)

```



3.3 Plagiarism Scoring & Thresholds



```go

type PlagiarismThresholds struct {

      ExactSentenceCritical float64 `json:"exact_sentence_critical"` // 1.0 (exact match)

      NearExactSentenceHigh float64 `json:"near_exact_sentence_high"` // 0.95
    SemanticHigh              float64 `json:"semantic_high"`       // 0.90

    SemanticMedium              float64 `json:"semantic_medium"`        // 0.85

    OverallOriginalityPass float64 `json:"overall_originality_pass"` // 85.0

}



func (pds *PlagiarismDetectionService) calculateRisk(

    report *PlagiarismReport,

) RiskLevel {



    criticalCount := 0

    highCount := 0



    for _, match := range report.Matches {

        switch match.Severity {

        case "CRITICAL":

            criticalCount++

        case "HIGH":

            highCount++

        }

    }



    if criticalCount > 0 {

        return RiskLevelCritical

    }



    if highCount > 3 {
          return RiskLevelHigh

      }



      if highCount > 0 {

          return RiskLevelMedium

      }



      if report.OriginalityScore < 80 {

          return RiskLevelMedium

      }



      return RiskLevelLow

}

4.2 Defamation Detection Algorithm



```python

class DefamationDetector:

      """

      Specialized defamation and libel detection.

      """



      DEFAMATION_INDICATORS = {

        "criminal_conduct": [

            "stole", "robbed", "murdered", "assaulted", "committed",

            "arrested for", "charged with", "convicted of", "guilty of",
         "crime", "criminal", "illegal", "fraud", "embezzled",

    ],

    "professional_misconduct": [

         "incompetent", "negligent", "malpractice", "corrupt",

         "bribed", "unethical", "violated", "breached",

    ],

    "personal_misconduct": [

         "lied", "cheated", "affair", "addict", "alcoholic",

         "bankrupt", "dishonest", "infidelity",

    ],

    "disease_claims": [

         "has HIV", "has AIDS", "has STD", "infected with",

         "mentally ill", "insane", "crazy",

    ],

}



async def detect_defamation_risk(

    self,

    content: str,

    subjects: List[Entity],

    locked_facts: LockedFactSet,

) -> List[DefamationRisk]:

    """

    Detect potential defamation risks in content.

    """
risks = []



for subject in subjects:

  # Get all statements about this subject

  statements = self.extract_statements_about(content, subject)



  for statement in statements:

     # Check for defamation indicators

     indicators_found = []

     for category, terms in self.DEFAMATION_INDICATORS.items():

        for term in terms:

             if term.lower() in statement.lower():

               indicators_found.append({

                    "category": category,

                    "term": term,

               })



     if not indicators_found:

        continue



     # Verify statement against locked facts

     verification = await self.verify_statement(statement, locked_facts)



     if not verification.verified:

        risk = DefamationRisk(

             subject=subject,
              statement=statement,

              indicators=indicators_found,

              verification=verification,

              risk_level=self.calculate_defamation_risk(

                   indicators_found, verification, subject

              ),

          )

          risks.append(risk)



  return risks



def calculate_defamation_risk(

  self,

  indicators: List[dict],

  verification: VerificationResult,

  subject: Entity,

) -> RiskLevel:

  """

  Calculate defamation risk level.

  """



  base_risk = RiskLevel.LOW



  # Criminal accusations are highest risk

  if any(i["category"] == "criminal_conduct" for i in indicators):

    base_risk = RiskLevel.CRITICAL
  # Professional misconduct is high risk

  elif any(i["category"] == "professional_misconduct" for i in indicators):

      base_risk = RiskLevel.HIGH



  # Personal misconduct is medium risk

  elif any(i["category"] == "personal_misconduct" for i in indicators):

      base_risk = RiskLevel.MEDIUM



  # If statement is unverified, escalate

  if not verification.verified:

      base_risk = self.escalate_risk(base_risk)



  # Public figures have higher burden of proof (actual malice)

  if subject.is_public_figure and verification.confidence < 0.9:

      base_risk = self.escalate_risk(base_risk)



  return base_risk



def escalate_risk(self, current: RiskLevel) -> RiskLevel:

  escalation = {

      RiskLevel.LOW: RiskLevel.MEDIUM,

      RiskLevel.MEDIUM: RiskLevel.HIGH,

      RiskLevel.HIGH: RiskLevel.CRITICAL,

      RiskLevel.CRITICAL: RiskLevel.CRITICAL,

  }
        return escalation.get(current, RiskLevel.CRITICAL)

```

class PrivacyProtectionService:

      """

      Detects and protects personally identifiable information (PII).

      """



      PII_PATTERNS = {

        "email": {

             "regex": r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b',

             "severity": "HIGH",

             "action": "REDACT_OR_CONSENT",

async def scan_for_pii(

    self,

    content: str,

    metadata: ContentMetadata,

    target_jurisdictions: List[str],

) -> PIIReport:

    """

    Scan content for PII and generate protection recommendations.

    """



    report = PIIReport(
    content_id=metadata.content_id,

    scanned_at=datetime.utcnow(),

)



findings = []



# 1. Regex-based PII detection

for pii_type, config in self.PII_PATTERNS.items():

    matches = re.finditer(config["regex"], content, re.IGNORECASE)



    for match in matches:

      # Check context requirements

      if "context_required" in config:

          if not self.has_context(match, content, config["context_required"]):

            continue



      finding = PIIFinding(

          pii_type=pii_type,

          severity=config["severity"],

          recommended_action=config["action"],

          match_text=match.group(),

          location=(match.start(), match.end()),

      )

      findings.append(finding)



# 2. NER-based PII detection (names, organizations that could be individuals)
  ner_findings = await self.detect_pii_with_ner(content)

  findings.extend(ner_findings)



  # 3. Apply jurisdiction-specific rules

  for jurisdiction in target_jurisdictions:

    rules = self.get_jurisdiction_rules(jurisdiction)

    if rules:

        findings = self.apply_jurisdiction_rules(findings, rules)



  # 4. Deduplicate and prioritize findings

  report.findings = self.prioritize_findings(findings)



  # 5. Generate redacted version

  report.redacted_content = self.generate_redacted_version(content, findings)



  # 6. Determine overall risk

  report.overall_risk = self.determine_pii_risk(findings)



  return report



async def detect_pii_with_ner(self, content: str) -> List[PIIFinding]:

  """

  Use Named Entity Recognition to detect potential PII.

  """



  findings = []
entities = await self.ner_model.extract_entities(content)



for entity in entities:

  if entity.type == "PERSON":

     # Check if person is a public figure (exempt from PII in many cases)

     is_public_figure = await self.is_public_figure(entity.text)



     if not is_public_figure:

       findings.append(PIIFinding(

            pii_type="person_name",

            severity="MEDIUM",

            recommended_action="REVIEW",

            match_text=entity.text,

            context="Non-public figure name detected",

       ))



  elif entity.type == "ORGANIZATION":

     # Some organizations are sole proprietorships (PII risk)

     if await self.is_likely_individual_business(entity.text):

       findings.append(PIIFinding(

            pii_type="potential_individual_business",

            severity="LOW",

            recommended_action="REVIEW",

            match_text=entity.text,

       ))
        return findings

5.2 Redaction & Anonymization



```go

type RedactionService struct {

      patterns map[string]*RedactionPattern

}



type RedactionPattern struct {

      PIType     PIType

      Replacement string

      Strategy   RedactionStrategy

}



type RedactionStrategy string

const (

      StrategyReplace RedactionStrategy = "REPLACE"       // Replace with [REDACTED]

      StrategyMask        RedactionStrategy = "MASK"   // Partial masking (e.g., ***-****-1234)

      StrategyAnonymize RedactionStrategy = "ANONYMIZE" // Replace with generic term

      StrategyRemove       RedactionStrategy = "REMOVE"    // Remove entirely

)



var RedactionPatterns = map[PIType]*RedactionPattern{
    PITypeEmail: {

         Replacement: "[EMAIL REDACTED]",

         Strategy: StrategyReplace,

    },

    PITypePhoneNumber: {

         Replacement: "[PHONE REDACTED]",

         Strategy: StrategyMask,

    },

    PITypeSSN: {

         Replacement: "***-**-****",

         Strategy: StrategyMask,

    },

    PITypePersonName: {

         Replacement: "[NAME REDACTED]",

         Strategy: StrategyAnonymize,

    },

    PITypeStreetAddress: {

         Replacement: "[ADDRESS REDACTED]",

         Strategy: StrategyReplace,

    },

}



func (rs *RedactionService) RedactContent(

    content string,

    findings []PIIFinding,

    strategy RedactionStrategy,
) (string, error) {



  // Sort findings by location (reverse order for safe replacement)

  sort.Slice(findings, func(i, j int) bool {

       return findings[i].Location.Start > findings[j].Location.Start

  })



  redacted := content



  for _, finding := range findings {

       pattern, ok := RedactionPatterns[finding.PIIType]

       if !ok {

           pattern = &RedactionPattern{

               Replacement: "[REDACTED]",

               Strategy: StrategyReplace,

           }

       }



       replacement := pattern.Replacement



       if strategy == StrategyMask {

           replacement = rs.maskValue(finding.MatchText, finding.PIIType)

       } else if strategy == StrategyAnonymize {

           replacement = rs.anonymizeValue(finding.MatchText, finding.PIIType)

       }
          // Replace in content

          redacted = redacted[:finding.Location.Start] +

                  replacement +

                  redacted[finding.Location.End:]

      }



      return redacted, nil

}



func (rs *RedactionService) maskValue(value string, piiType PIType) string {

      switch piiType {

      case PITypePhoneNumber:

          // Mask all but last 4 digits

          if len(value) >= 4 {

              return strings.Repeat("*", len(value)-4) + value[len(value)-4:]

          }

      case PITypeSSN:

          return "***-**-" + value[len(value)-4:]

      case PITypeCreditCard:

          return "****-****-****-" + value[len(value)-4:]

      default:

          return "[MASKED]"

      }

}

class AISafetyReviewService:

  """

  Reviews AI-generated content for safety and reliability.

  """



  def __init__(self):

      self.hallucination_detector = HallucinationDetector()

      self.quote_validator = QuoteValidator()

      self.statistic_validator = StatisticValidator()

      self.source_validator = SourceValidator()

      self.citation_validator = CitationValidator()

      self.coherence_checker = CoherenceChecker()



  async def review_ai_safety(

      self,

      content: GeneratedContent,
  locked_facts: LockedFactSet,

  generation_metadata: GenerationMetadata,

) -> AISafetyReport:

  """

  Comprehensive AI safety review.

  """



  report = AISafetyReport(

      content_id=content.id,

      reviewed_at=datetime.utcnow(),

  )



  # Run all checks in parallel

  tasks = [

      self.hallucination_detector.check(content, locked_facts),

      self.quote_validator.check(content, locked_facts),

      self.statistic_validator.check(content, locked_facts),

      self.source_validator.check(content, locked_facts),

      self.citation_validator.check(content, locked_facts),

      self.coherence_checker.check(content),

  ]



  results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)



  # Aggregate results

  for result in results:
    report.check_results.append(result)



  # Calculate AI Safety Score

  report.ai_safety_score = self.calculate_safety_score(results)



  # Calculate Trust Score

  report.trust_score = self.calculate_trust_score(results, generation_metadata)



  # Calculate Confidence Score

  report.confidence_score = self.calculate_confidence(report)



  # Generate publication recommendation

  report.publication_recommendation = self.generate_recommendation(report)



  return report



async def detect_hallucinations(

  self,

  content: GeneratedContent,

  locked_facts: LockedFactSet,

) -> HallucinationReport:

  """

  Detect AI hallucinations in generated content.

  """



  report = HallucinationReport()
# Extract all factual claims from generated content

generated_claims = await self.extract_claims(content.full_text)



hallucinations = []



for claim in generated_claims:

  # Check claim against locked facts

  match = self.find_matching_fact(claim, locked_facts)



  if not match:

    # Potential hallucination

    confidence = await self.assess_hallucination_confidence(claim, content)



    hallucinations.append(HallucinationFinding(

         claim=claim.text,

         claim_type=claim.type,

         confidence=confidence,

         severity="CRITICAL" if confidence > 0.8 else "HIGH",

         evidence="Claim not found in verified fact set",

    ))

  elif not self.is_accurate_representation(claim, match):

    # Distortion of verified fact

    hallucinations.append(HallucinationFinding(

         claim=claim.text,

         claim_type=claim.type,
               confidence=0.9,

               severity="HIGH",

               evidence=f"Claim distorts verified fact: {match.FactText[:100]}",

          ))



  # Check for fabricated entities

  entities = self.extract_entities(content.full_text)

  for entity in entities:

    if not self.entity_in_locked_facts(entity, locked_facts):

          if not await self.is_well_known_entity(entity):

               hallucinations.append(HallucinationFinding(

                    claim=f"Entity: {entity.name}",

                    claim_type="ENTITY",

                    confidence=0.7,

                    severity="MEDIUM",

                    evidence="Entity not in verified fact set",

               ))



  report.hallucinations = hallucinations

  report.hallucination_count = len(hallucinations)

  report.critical_count = len([h for h in hallucinations if h.severity == "CRITICAL"])



  return report



async def validate_quotes(

  self,
  content: GeneratedContent,

  locked_facts: LockedFactSet,

) -> QuoteValidationReport:

  """

  Verify all quotes in content match verified quotes exactly.

  """



  report = QuoteValidationReport()



  # Extract all quotes from content

  content_quotes = self.extract_quotes(content.full_text)



  issues = []



  for quote in content_quotes:

    # Find matching verified quote

    verified_quote = self.find_matching_quote(quote, locked_facts.AttributedQuotes)



    if not verified_quote:

        issues.append(QuoteIssue(

             quote_text=quote.text[:100],

             issue_type="FABRICATED_QUOTE",

             severity="CRITICAL",

             detail="Quote not found in verified source",

        ))

        continue
        # Check verbatim accuracy

        if quote.text != verified_quote.QuoteText:

          issues.append(QuoteIssue(

               quote_text=quote.text[:100],

               issue_type="QUOTE_ALTERED",

               severity="CRITICAL",

               detail="Quote text differs from verified original",

               expected=verified_quote.QuoteText[:100],

          ))



        # Check attribution

        if quote.attribution != verified_quote.Attribution:

          issues.append(QuoteIssue(

               quote_text=quote.text[:100],

               issue_type="ATTRIBUTION_MISMATCH",

               severity="HIGH",

               detail=f"Attribution mismatch. Expected: {verified_quote.Attribution}",

          ))



      report.issues = issues

      report.is_valid = len(issues) == 0



      return report

6.2 AI Safety Scoring



```go

type AISafetyScorer struct {

    weights SafetyScoreWeights

}



type SafetyScoreWeights struct {

    HallucinationWeight float64 // 0.35

    QuoteAccuracyWeight float64 // 0.25

    StatisticAccuracyWeight float64 // 0.20

    SourceAttributionWeight float64 // 0.10

    CoherenceWeight        float64 // 0.10

}



func (ass *AISafetyScorer) CalculateAISafetyScore(

    report *AISafetyReport,

) float64 {



    score := 100.0



    // Hallucination penalty

    if report.HallucinationResult != nil {

      criticalHals := report.HallucinationResult.CriticalCount

      totalHals := report.HallucinationResult.HallucinationCount
          score -= float64(criticalHals) * 25.0 // Each critical hallucination: -25

          score -= float64(totalHals-criticalHals) * 10.0 // Each non-critical: -10

      }



      // Quote accuracy penalty

      if report.QuoteValidationResult != nil {

          fabricatedQuotes := len(report.QuoteValidationResult.FabricatedQuotes)

          alteredQuotes := len(report.QuoteValidationResult.AlteredQuotes)



          score -= float64(fabricatedQuotes) * 30.0

          score -= float64(alteredQuotes) * 15.0

      }



      // Statistic accuracy penalty

      if report.StatisticValidationResult != nil {

          score -= float64(report.StatisticValidationResult.InaccurateStats) * 10.0

      }



      return math.Max(0, math.Min(100, score))

}

func (pps *PlatformPolicyService) ValidateForPlatform(

    ctx context.Context,

    content *ContentPackage,

    platform string,

) (*PlatformComplianceResult, error) {



    policy, exists := pps.platformPolicies[platform]

    if !exists {

         return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown platform: %s", platform)

    }



    result := &PlatformComplianceResult{
    Platform: platform,

    ContentID: content.ID,

    CheckedAt: time.Now(),

    IsCompliant: true,

}



// 1. Check prohibited topics

for _, topic := range policy.ProhibitedTopics {

    if pps.containsTopic(content, topic) {

        result.IsCompliant = false

        result.Violations = append(result.Violations, PolicyViolation{

             Type:   "PROHIBITED_TOPIC",

             Topic: topic,

             Severity: "CRITICAL",

             Message: fmt.Sprintf("Content contains prohibited topic: %s", topic),

             Action: "REMOVE_OR_BLOCK",

        })

    }

}



// 2. Check restricted topics

for _, restricted := range policy.RestrictedTopics {

    if pps.containsTopic(content, restricted.Topic) {

        if !pps.meetsRequirements(content, restricted.AllowedWith) {

             result.IsCompliant = false

             result.Violations = append(result.Violations, PolicyViolation{
                    Type:    "RESTRICTED_TOPIC",

                    Topic: restricted.Topic,

                    Severity: "HIGH",

            Message: fmt.Sprintf("Content contains restricted topic without required conditions:
%s", restricted.Topic),

                    Action: "ADD_REQUIREMENTS_OR_REMOVE",

               })

          }

          if restricted.RequiresLabel {

               result.RequiredLabels = append(result.RequiredLabels, restricted.LabelText)

          }

      }

  }



  // 3. Check content rules

  for _, rule := range policy.ContentRules {

      if !rule.Check(content) {

          result.Violations = append(result.Violations, PolicyViolation{

               Type:        "CONTENT_RULE",

               RuleID: rule.RuleID,

               Severity: "MEDIUM",

               Message: rule.Description,

               Action: "CORRECT",

          })

      }

  }
    // 4. Check format requirements

    formatViolations := pps.checkFormatRequirements(content, policy.FormatRules)

    result.Violations = append(result.Violations, formatViolations...)



    // 5. Check required disclosures

    for _, disclosure := range policy.RequiredDisclosures {

        if !pps.hasDisclosure(content, disclosure) {

            result.RequiredDisclosures = append(result.RequiredDisclosures, disclosure)

        }

    }



    // Generate corrections if possible

    if !result.IsCompliant {

        result.SuggestedCorrections = pps.generateCorrections(result.Violations)

    }



    return result, nil

}



func (pps *PlatformPolicyService) checkClickbait(content *ContentPackage) bool {

    // Check for clickbait patterns

    clickbaitPatterns := []string{

        "you won't believe",

        "what happens next",

        "this will shock you",
          "mind blowing",

          "doctors hate",

          "one weird trick",

          "secret they don't want you to know",

      }



      text := strings.ToLower(content.Headline)

      for _, pattern := range clickbaitPatterns {

          if strings.Contains(text, pattern) {

              return false

          }

      }



      return true

}

PART VIII — EDITORIAL APPROVAL WORKFLOW



8.1 Approval State Machine



```go

type ApprovalWorkflowEngine struct {

      stateMachine *ApprovalStateMachine
    routingEngine *RoutingEngine

    notificationSvc NotificationService

    auditLogger    AuditLogger

}



type ApprovalState string

const (

    ApprovalStateSubmitted       ApprovalState = "SUBMITTED"

    ApprovalStateAIReview        ApprovalState = "AI_REVIEW"

    ApprovalStateComplianceReview ApprovalState = "COMPLIANCE_REVIEW"

    ApprovalStateLegalReview      ApprovalState = "LEGAL_REVIEW"

    ApprovalStateHumanReview        ApprovalState = "HUMAN_REVIEW"

    ApprovalStateApproved        ApprovalState = "APPROVED"

    ApprovalStateRejected        ApprovalState = "REJECTED"

    ApprovalStateReturnedForEdit ApprovalState = "RETURNED_FOR_EDIT"

    ApprovalStatePublished       ApprovalState = "PUBLISHED"

    ApprovalStateEmergencyOverride ApprovalState = "EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE"

)



type ApprovalWorkflow struct {

    WorkflowID      string       `json:"workflow_id"`

    ContentPackageID string         `json:"content_package_id"`

    CurrentState ApprovalState        `json:"current_state"`

    RiskLevel     RiskLevel      `json:"risk_level"`

    ReviewPath     ReviewPath        `json:"review_path"`

    RequiredReviews []ReviewType          `json:"required_reviews"`
    CompletedReviews []CompletedReview `json:"completed_reviews"`

    Deadline       *time.Time       `json:"deadline"`

    CreatedAt      time.Time        `json:"created_at"`

    UpdatedAt       time.Time       `json:"updated_at"`

}



type ReviewPath string

const (

    ReviewPathStandard ReviewPath = "STANDARD" // Normal review flow

    ReviewPathBreaking ReviewPath = "BREAKING" // Accelerated for breaking news

    ReviewPathHighRisk ReviewPath = "HIGH_RISK" // Enhanced review for risky content

    ReviewPathEmergency ReviewPath = "EMERGENCY" // Emergency override path

)



func (awe *ApprovalWorkflowEngine) RouteContent(

    ctx context.Context,

    content *ContentPackage,

    complianceResult *ComplianceResult,

) (*ApprovalWorkflow, error) {



    workflow := &ApprovalWorkflow{

      WorkflowID:       uuid.NewV7().String(),

      ContentPackageID: content.ID,

      CurrentState:    ApprovalStateSubmitted,

      RiskLevel:      complianceResult.OverallRisk,

      CreatedAt:      time.Now(),
}



// Determine review path based on risk and content type

workflow.ReviewPath = awe.determineReviewPath(content, complianceResult)



// Determine required reviews

workflow.RequiredReviews = awe.determineRequiredReviews(complianceResult)



// Set deadline based on review path

workflow.Deadline = awe.calculateDeadline(workflow.ReviewPath)



// Route to first review stage

switch workflow.ReviewPath {

case ReviewPathStandard:

    workflow.CurrentState = ApprovalStateAIReview



case ReviewPathBreaking:

    // Breaking news: parallel AI + human review, 5-minute deadline

    workflow.CurrentState = ApprovalStateHumanReview

    workflow.Deadline = timePtr(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Minute))



case ReviewPathHighRisk:

    // High risk: mandatory legal review

    workflow.CurrentState = ApprovalStateLegalReview



case ReviewPathEmergency:
        // Emergency: override with post-publication review

        workflow.CurrentState = ApprovalStateEmergencyOverride

    }



    // Save workflow

    if err := awe.saveWorkflow(ctx, workflow); err != nil {

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("save workflow: %w", err)

    }



    // Notify appropriate reviewers

    awe.notifyReviewers(ctx, workflow)



    // Log workflow creation

    awe.auditLogger.LogWorkflowCreated(ctx, workflow)



    return workflow, nil

}



func (awe *ApprovalWorkflowEngine) determineReviewPath(

    content *ContentPackage,

    result *ComplianceResult,

) ReviewPath {



    // Emergency content (public safety, imminent threat warnings)

    if content.IsEmergencyContent {

        return ReviewPathEmergency
    }



    // Breaking news

    if content.IsBreakingNews && result.OverallRisk <= RiskLevelMedium {

        return ReviewPathBreaking

    }



    // High-risk content

    if result.OverallRisk >= RiskLevelHigh {

        return ReviewPathHighRisk

    }



    return ReviewPathStandard

}



func (awe *ApprovalWorkflowEngine) determineRequiredReviews(

    result *ComplianceResult,

) []ReviewType {



    reviews := []ReviewType{ReviewTypeAIReview}



    if result.CopyrightRisk >= RiskLevelMedium {

        reviews = append(reviews, ReviewTypeRightsReview)

    }



    if result.LegalRisk >= RiskLevelHigh {
          reviews = append(reviews, ReviewTypeLegalReview)

      }



      if result.PrivacyRisk >= RiskLevelMedium {

          reviews = append(reviews, ReviewTypePrivacyReview)

      }



      if result.AISafetyRisk >= RiskLevelHigh {

          reviews = append(reviews, ReviewTypeAISafetyReview)

      }



      if result.OverallRisk >= RiskLevelHigh {

          reviews = append(reviews, ReviewTypeHumanEditorial)

      }



      return reviews

}

```



8.2 Emergency Publication Override



```go

type EmergencyOverrideService struct {

      authorizationChecker AuthorizationChecker

      auditLogger       AuditLogger

      notificationSvc    NotificationService
}



type EmergencyOverride struct {

    OverrideID string `json:"override_id"`

    ContentID      string `json:"content_id"`

    RequestedBy string `json:"requested_by"`

    Reason        string `json:"reason"`

    Authorization string `json:"authorization"` // Multi-factor auth token

    OverriddenChecks []string `json:"overridden_checks"`

    PostPublishReview bool `json:"post_publish_review"` // Must be true

    CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`

    ExpiresAt     time.Time `json:"expires_at"` // Override validity window

}



func (eos *EmergencyOverrideService) RequestEmergencyOverride(

    ctx context.Context,

    contentID string,

    requestedBy string,

    reason string,

    authorizationToken string,

) (*EmergencyOverride, error) {



    // 1. Verify authorization (requires senior editor or above)

    if !eos.authorizationChecker.HasEmergencyAuthority(ctx, requestedBy) {

        return nil, ErrInsufficientAuthority

    }
// 2. Verify multi-factor authorization

if !eos.authorizationChecker.VerifyMFA(ctx, requestedBy, authorizationToken) {

    return nil, ErrMFARRequired

}



// 3. Validate emergency reason

if !eos.isValidEmergencyReason(reason) {

    return nil, ErrInvalidEmergencyReason

}



// 4. Create override

override := &EmergencyOverride{

    OverrideID: uuid.NewV7().String(),

    ContentID:    contentID,

    RequestedBy: requestedBy,

    Reason:      reason,

    Authorization: authorizationToken,

    PostPublishReview: true, // Always required

    CreatedAt:    time.Now(),

    ExpiresAt:   time.Now().Add(1 * time.Hour),

}



// 5. Log override (critical audit event)

eos.auditLogger.LogEmergencyOverride(ctx, override)
      // 6. Notify legal/compliance teams

      eos.notificationSvc.NotifyEmergencyOverride(ctx, override)



      // 7. Schedule post-publication review

      eos.schedulePostPublishReview(ctx, override, 1*time.Hour)



      return override, nil

}

PART IX — COMPLIANCE SCORING ENGINE



Service ID: SVC-CMP-SCORING

Runtime: Golang



9.1 Scoring Algorithm



```go

type ComplianceScoringEngine struct {

      weights ComplianceWeights

      thresholds ComplianceThresholds

}



type ComplianceWeights struct {
    CopyrightWeight float64 `json:"copyright_weight"` // 0.20

    PlagiarismWeight float64 `json:"plagiarism_weight"` // 0.15

    LegalWeight      float64 `json:"legal_weight"`    // 0.25

    PrivacyWeight float64 `json:"privacy_weight"`          // 0.15

    AISafetyWeight float64 `json:"ai_safety_weight"` // 0.15

    PlatformWeight float64 `json:"platform_weight"` // 0.10

}



type ComplianceScore struct {

    ContentID         string       `json:"content_id"`



    // Individual Scores (0-100)

    CopyrightScore      float64       `json:"copyright_score"`

    PlagiarismScore     float64       `json:"plagiarism_score"`

    LegalScore        float64       `json:"legal_score"`

    PrivacyScore      float64        `json:"privacy_score"`

    AISafetyScore      float64       `json:"ai_safety_score"`

    PlatformScore      float64       `json:"platform_score"`



    // Composite Scores

    OverallComplianceScore float64         `json:"overall_compliance_score"`

    PublicationReadinessScore float64      `json:"publication_readiness_score"`

    RiskScore         float64      `json:"risk_score"`



    // Status

    PublicationRecommendation string         `json:"publication_recommendation"`
    RiskLevel          RiskLevel      `json:"risk_level"`

    BlockingIssues         []string     `json:"blocking_issues"`

    Warnings            []string      `json:"warnings"`



    CalculatedAt time.Time               `json:"calculated_at"`

}



func (cse *ComplianceScoringEngine) CalculateComplianceScore(

    ctx context.Context,

    results *AggregatedComplianceResults,

) (*ComplianceScore, error) {



    score := &ComplianceScore{

        ContentID: results.ContentID,

        CalculatedAt: time.Now(),

    }



    // Calculate individual scores

    score.CopyrightScore = cse.calculateCopyrightScore(results.RightsResult)

    score.PlagiarismScore = cse.calculatePlagiarismScore(results.PlagiarismResult)

    score.LegalScore = cse.calculateLegalScore(results.LegalResult)

    score.PrivacyScore = cse.calculatePrivacyScore(results.PrivacyResult)

    score.AISafetyScore = cse.calculateAISafetyScore(results.AISafetyResult)

    score.PlatformScore = cse.calculatePlatformScore(results.PlatformResults)



    // Calculate overall compliance score
w := cse.weights

score.OverallComplianceScore =

    (score.CopyrightScore * w.CopyrightWeight) +

    (score.PlagiarismScore * w.PlagiarismWeight) +

    (score.LegalScore * w.LegalWeight) +

    (score.PrivacyScore * w.PrivacyWeight) +

    (score.AISafetyScore * w.AISafetyWeight) +

    (score.PlatformScore * w.PlatformWeight)



// Calculate risk score (inverse of compliance, weighted by severity)

score.RiskScore = 100 - score.OverallComplianceScore



// Identify blocking issues (any score below critical threshold)

thresholds := map[string]float64{

    "copyright": 60.0,

    "plagiarism": 70.0,

    "legal": 50.0,

    "privacy": 50.0,

    "ai_safety": 60.0,

}



for category, threshold := range thresholds {

    categoryScore := cse.getCategoryScore(score, category)

    if categoryScore < threshold {

      score.BlockingIssues = append(score.BlockingIssues,

        fmt.Sprintf("%s score %.1f below threshold %.1f", category, categoryScore, threshold))
        }

    }



    // Calculate publication readiness

    score.PublicationReadinessScore = cse.calculatePublicationReadiness(score)



    // Determine risk level

    score.RiskLevel = cse.determineRiskLevel(score)



    // Generate publication recommendation

    score.PublicationRecommendation = cse.generateRecommendation(score)



    return score, nil

}



func (cse *ComplianceScoringEngine) calculatePublicationReadiness(

    score *ComplianceScore,

) float64 {



    readiness := score.OverallComplianceScore



    // Reduce readiness if any blocking issues exist

    readiness -= float64(len(score.BlockingIssues)) * 10.0



    // Reduce readiness for CRITICAL risk

    if score.RiskLevel == RiskLevelCritical {
        readiness -= 30.0

    }



    return math.Max(0, math.Min(100, readiness))

}



func (cse *ComplianceScoringEngine) determineRiskLevel(

    score *ComplianceScore,

) RiskLevel {



    if len(score.BlockingIssues) > 0 {

        // Check for critical issues

        for _, issue := range score.BlockingIssues {

            if strings.Contains(issue, "legal") ||

                strings.Contains(issue, "privacy") {

                return RiskLevelCritical

            }

        }

        return RiskLevelHigh

    }



    if score.OverallComplianceScore < 70 {

        return RiskLevelHigh

    }



    if score.OverallComplianceScore < 85 {
        return RiskLevelMedium

    }



    return RiskLevelLow

}



func (cse *ComplianceScoringEngine) generateRecommendation(

    score *ComplianceScore,

) string {



    switch score.RiskLevel {

    case RiskLevelCritical:

        return "BLOCK - Critical compliance issues must be resolved before publication"

    case RiskLevelHigh:

     return "HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED - Significant compliance concerns require editorial
review"

    case RiskLevelMedium:

        if score.PublicationReadinessScore >= 80 {

       return "PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION - Minor issues noted, proceed with automated
publication"

        }

    return "HUMAN_REVIEW_RECOMMENDED - Moderate concerns, human review
recommended"

    case RiskLevelLow:

        return "APPROVED - Content passes all compliance checks, safe to publish"

    default:

        return "REVIEW_REQUIRED"
      }

}

```

```go

type ComplianceAuditService struct {

      auditLog *ImmutableAuditLog

      eventBus kafka.Producer

}



type ComplianceAuditEntry struct {

      EntryID     string         `json:"entry_id"`

      PreviousHash string            `json:"previous_hash"`

      Timestamp      time.Time         `json:"timestamp"`

      Actor       AuditActor       `json:"actor"`

      Action      AuditAction       `json:"action"`

      ContentID     string         `json:"content_id"`

      Decision     ComplianceDecision `json:"decision"`

      Evidence     json.RawMessage       `json:"evidence"`

      Hash        string         `json:"hash"`
}



type ComplianceDecision struct {

    DecisionID      string      `json:"decision_id"`

    DecisionType string           `json:"decision_type"`

    Result        string      `json:"result"`

    Scores        *ComplianceScore `json:"scores,omitempty"`

    ReviewerID       string      `json:"reviewer_id,omitempty"`

    ReviewerType string            `json:"reviewer_type"` // AI, HUMAN, HYBRID

    Notes         string      `json:"notes,omitempty"`

    OverrideReason string           `json:"override_reason,omitempty"`

}



func (cas *ComplianceAuditService) RecordDecision(

    ctx context.Context,

    actor AuditActor,

    contentID string,

    decision ComplianceDecision,

    evidence interface{},

) (*ComplianceAuditEntry, error) {



    // Get last entry for chain continuity

    lastEntry, _ := cas.auditLog.GetLastEntry(ctx, contentID)



    previousHash := ""

    if lastEntry != nil {
    previousHash = lastEntry.Hash

}



// Serialize evidence

evidenceJSON, _ := json.Marshal(evidence)



// Create entry

entry := &ComplianceAuditEntry{

    EntryID:    uuid.NewV7().String(),

    PreviousHash: previousHash,

    Timestamp: time.Now(),

    Actor:      actor,

    Action:     cas.determineAction(decision),

    ContentID: contentID,

    Decision:    decision,

    Evidence:    evidenceJSON,

}



// Calculate hash (cryptographic chain)

entry.Hash = cas.calculateHash(entry)



// Append to immutable log

if err := cas.auditLog.Append(ctx, entry); err != nil {

    return nil, fmt.Errorf("append to audit log: %w", err)

}
    // Publish audit event

    cas.eventBus.Publish(ctx, "compliance.audit.entry", entry)



    return entry, nil

}



func (cas *ComplianceAuditService) VerifyAuditChain(

    ctx context.Context,

    contentID string,

) (*ChainVerificationReport, error) {



    entries, err := cas.auditLog.GetFullChain(ctx, contentID)

    if err != nil {

        return nil, err

    }



    report := &ChainVerificationReport{

        ContentID:        contentID,

        TotalEntries: len(entries),

        Verified:     true,

        CheckedAt:        time.Now(),

    }



    var previousHash string



    for i, entry := range entries {
        // Verify chain link

        if entry.PreviousHash != previousHash {

            report.Verified = false

            report.BreakPoint = i

            report.ExpectedHash = previousHash

            report.FoundHash = entry.PreviousHash

            break

        }



        // Verify entry integrity

        calculatedHash := cas.calculateHash(&entry)

        if calculatedHash != entry.Hash {

            report.Verified = false

            report.BreakPoint = i

            report.ExpectedHash = calculatedHash

            report.FoundHash = entry.Hash

            break

        }



        previousHash = entry.Hash

    }



    return report, nil

}



func (cas *ComplianceAuditService) GetComplianceHistory(
      ctx context.Context,

      contentID string,

) (*ComplianceHistory, error) {



      entries, err := cas.auditLog.GetFullChain(ctx, contentID)

      if err != nil {

          return nil, err

      }



      history := &ComplianceHistory{

          ContentID: contentID,

          Timeline: make([]ComplianceEvent, 0),

      }



      for _, entry := range entries {

          history.Timeline = append(history.Timeline, ComplianceEvent{

               Timestamp: entry.Timestamp,

               Actor:   entry.Actor,

               Action: entry.Action,

               Decision: entry.Decision,

          })

      }



      return history, nil

}

PART XII — ENTERPRISE ADRs



```markdown

## ADR-CMP-001: Pre-Publication Compliance Gateway

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** All content must pass through Compliance Gatekeeper synchronously before
distribution.

**Rationale:** Legal and regulatory risks require a hard gateway. Post-publication corrections
are reputationally damaging.

**Consequences:** Added latency to publishing pipeline, but essential risk mitigation.



## ADR-CMP-002: Tiered Risk Classification
**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Four-tier system (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL) with automated handling for
lower tiers.

**Rationale:** 85% of content expected LOW/MEDIUM risk. Human review for everything
doesn't scale.

**Consequences:** Some risk of automated misclassification, mitigated by continuous model
improvement.



## ADR-CMP-003: Immutable Cryptographic Audit Trail

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** SHA-256 chained audit log for all compliance decisions.

**Rationale:** Regulatory compliance and legal defensibility require tamper-proof records.

**Consequences:** Storage overhead for audit logs, but essential for legal protection.



## ADR-CMP-004: Independent Scoring Engine

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Compliance scores calculated independently from individual checkers.

**Rationale:** Prevents single checker from dominating decision; enables weighted, nuanced
scoring.

**Consequences:** More complex scoring logic but more accurate risk assessment.



## ADR-CMP-005: Emergency Override with Post-Publication Review

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Emergency override available for public safety content, but always triggers post-
publication review.

**Rationale:** Public safety sometimes requires speed over thoroughness, but accountability
must follow.

**Consequences:** Risk of misuse, mitigated by MFA requirement and mandatory post-review.
## ADR-CMP-006: Jurisdiction-Aware Privacy Protection

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Privacy rules adapt based on target jurisdictions (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).

**Rationale:** Different jurisdictions have different requirements; one-size-fits-all is
insufficient.

**Consequences:** More complex rule management but necessary for global compliance.



## ADR-CMP-007: Platform Policy as Configurable Rules

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Platform policies stored as configurable rule sets, not hardcoded logic.

**Rationale:** Platform policies change frequently; configurable rules enable rapid adaptation.

**Consequences:** Rule management overhead but critical for platform compliance.

```

ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORDS (ADR)



ADR-DIST-001: Connector Plugin Architecture



Decision: Implement platform connectors as independent, hot-swappable plugins behind a
unified interface, not as monolithic integrations.

Rationale: Platforms change APIs frequently, new platforms emerge, and different tenants may
need different platform mixes. Plugin architecture enables independent deployment, testing,
and scaling of each connector.

Alternatives Considered: Monolithic integration layer (rejected — not scalable); third-party
social media management API (rejected — insufficient control, latency, and cost at scale).



ADR-DIST-002: Event-Sourced Publication State



Decision: Use event sourcing for all publication state changes, with Kafka as the event store and
PostgreSQL for materialized views.
Rationale: Publication is inherently event-driven. Event sourcing provides complete audit trail,
enables replay for recovery, and supports real-time monitoring.

Alternatives Considered: Traditional CRUD with state in PostgreSQL (rejected — insufficient for
complex distributed publication tracking).



ADR-DIST-003: Priority-Based Publication Queues



Decision: Implement four priority queues (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) with preemptive
scheduling for breaking news.

Rationale: Breaking news and corrections must publish immediately; scheduled content can
wait. Priority queuing ensures critical content never waits behind bulk scheduled publications.

Consequences: More complex queue management but essential for news platform
requirements.



ADR-DIST-004: Idempotent Publication with Content Hashing



Decision: Every publication request carries a content hash; platforms detect duplicate
submissions via hash comparison.

Rationale: Network failures and retries can cause duplicate publications. Content hashing
enables safe retry without duplicate posts.

Consequences: Additional hash computation but eliminates duplicate publication risk.

PART I — DISTRIBUTION ENGINE OVERVIEW



1.1 Purpose, Scope & Domain Boundaries
Purpose: The Distribution Engine is the final stage of the Agbofa Nexus AI pipeline. It takes
compliance-approved content packages and delivers them to every target platform at the
optimal time, in the correct format, while monitoring delivery status and handling the full
lifecycle of published content.



Scope:



· Publication orchestration across 15+ platforms

· Platform-native content transformation

· Intelligent scheduling with timezone awareness

· Breaking news fast-path delivery

· Story update synchronization

· Correction and retraction management

· Delivery monitoring and analytics feedback



Domain Boundaries:



```

DISTRIBUTION ENGINE BOUNDED CONTEXT:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

│            DISTRIBUTION ENGINE                    │

│                                      │

│ INBOUND:                                   │

│ • Approved Content Packages (from Compliance Gatekeeper)            │

│ • Update/Cancellation Requests (from Editorial)            │

│ • Platform Policy Updates (from Config Service)            │

│ • Analytics Feedback (from Platforms)                  │
│                                       │

│ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │

---



PART II — PUBLICATION ORCHESTRATOR



Service ID: SVC-DIST-ORCHESTRATOR

Runtime: Golang

Primary Store: PostgreSQL (state), Kafka (events)



2.1 Service Overview



The Publication Orchestrator is the central coordinator for all distribution activities. It receives
approved content, determines publication strategy, assigns work to platform connectors, and
maintains the definitive publication state for every piece of content.



2.2 Domain Model
```go

2.3 Publication State Machine



```go

type PublicationStateMachine struct {

      transitions map[PublicationStatus]map[PublicationEvent]PublicationStatus

}



type PublicationEvent string

const (

      EventContentReceived PublicationEvent = "CONTENT_RECEIVED"

      EventScheduled         PublicationEvent = "SCHEDULED"

      EventScheduleReached PublicationEvent = "SCHEDULE_REACHED"

      EventAdaptationComplete PublicationEvent = "ADAPTATION_COMPLETE"

      EventPublishingStarted PublicationEvent = "PUBLISHING_STARTED"

      EventPlatformSuccess PublicationEvent = "PLATFORM_SUCCESS"

      EventPlatformFailed     PublicationEvent = "PLATFORM_FAILED"

      EventAllPlatformsDone PublicationEvent = "ALL_PLATFORMS_DONE"
    EventPartialSuccess     PublicationEvent = "PARTIAL_SUCCESS"

    EventRetryStarted       PublicationEvent = "RETRY_STARTED"

    EventMaxRetriesExceeded PublicationEvent = "MAX_RETRIES_EXCEEDED"

    EventCancelRequested PublicationEvent = "CANCEL_REQUESTED"

    EventRetractionRequested PublicationEvent = "RETRACTION_REQUESTED"

    EventUpdateReceived        PublicationEvent = "UPDATE_RECEIVED"

)



func NewPublicationStateMachine() *PublicationStateMachine {

    return &PublicationStateMachine{

      transitions: map[PublicationStatus]map[PublicationEvent]PublicationStatus{

        StatusQueued: {

             EventContentReceived: StatusQueued,

             EventScheduled:        StatusScheduled,

             EventPublishingStarted: StatusPublishing, // Immediate publish

        },

        StatusScheduled: {

             EventScheduleReached: StatusAdapting,

             EventCancelRequested: StatusCancelled,

             EventUpdateReceived: StatusQueued, // Re-queue with update

        },

        StatusAdapting: {

             EventAdaptationComplete: StatusPublishing,

             EventPlatformFailed:     StatusFailed,

        },

        StatusPublishing: {
     EventAllPlatformsDone: StatusPublished,

     EventPartialSuccess:   StatusPartialSuccess,

     EventPlatformFailed:   StatusRetrying,

},

StatusPartialSuccess: {

     EventRetryStarted:     StatusRetrying,

     EventAllPlatformsDone: StatusPublished,

},

StatusRetrying: {

     EventPlatformSuccess: StatusPublished,

     EventMaxRetriesExceeded: StatusPartialSuccess,

},

StatusPublished: {

     EventUpdateReceived:     StatusQueued, // New update job

     EventRetractionRequested: StatusRetracting,

},

StatusFailed: {

     EventRetryStarted:     StatusRetrying,

     EventCancelRequested: StatusCancelled,

},

StatusCancelled: {

     // Terminal state

},

StatusRetracted: {

     // Terminal state

},
          },

      }

}

    string tenant_id = 1;

    string idempotency_key = 6;

    oneof timing {

        ImmediatePublish immediate = 1;

        ScheduledPublish scheduled = 2;

        EmbargoPublish embargo = 3;

    }

    bool use_breaking_news_path = 1;
}

      string publish_at = 1; // ISO 8601

      string timezone = 2; // IANA timezone

}

      string timezone = 2;

2.5 Orchestration Logic



```go

func (po *PublicationOrchestrator) SubmitJob(

      ctx context.Context,

      request *SubmitPublicationJobRequest,

) (*PublicationJob, error) {



      // 1. Validate content package exists and is approved

      contentPackage, err := po.getApprovedContent(ctx, request.ContentPackageID)

      if err != nil {

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("content retrieval: %w", err)
}



// 2. Idempotency check

if request.IdempotencyKey != "" {

    existing, _ := po.stateManager.FindByKey(ctx, request.IdempotencyKey)

    if existing != nil {

        return existing, nil

    }

}



// 3. Create publication job

job := &PublicationJob{

    JobID:         uuid.NewV7().String(),

    ContentPackageID: request.ContentPackageID,

    StoryID:        contentPackage.StoryID,

    JobType:         JobTypeInitial,

    Priority:      request.Priority,

    TargetPlatforms: request.Targets,

    ContentPackage: contentPackage,

    MaxRetries:        3,

    CreatedAt:        time.Now(),

    UpdatedAt:         time.Now(),

}



// 4. Determine timing

if request.Schedule != nil {
    switch {

    case request.Schedule.Immediate != nil:

        job.Status = StatusQueued

        job.ScheduledFor = nil



    case request.Schedule.Scheduled != nil:

        scheduledTime, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, request.Schedule.Scheduled.PublishAt)

        job.Status = StatusScheduled

        job.ScheduledFor = &scheduledTime



    case request.Schedule.Embargo != nil:

        embargoTime, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, request.Schedule.Embargo.EmbargoUntil)

        job.Status = StatusScheduled

        job.EmbargoUntil = &embargoTime

        job.ScheduledFor = &embargoTime

    }

} else {

    job.Status = StatusQueued

}



// 5. Save job

if err := po.stateManager.SaveJob(ctx, job); err != nil {

    return nil, fmt.Errorf("save job: %w", err)

}



// 6. Publish event
     po.eventBus.Publish(ctx, "distribution.job.created", job)



     // 7. Route to appropriate queue

     if job.Status == StatusQueued {

         if job.Priority == PriorityCritical {

             // Immediate processing for critical content

             go po.processJob(context.Background(), job)

         } else {

             po.scheduler.Enqueue(ctx, job)

         }

     } else {

         po.scheduler.Schedule(ctx, job)

     }



     return job, nil

}



func (po *PublicationOrchestrator) processJob(

     ctx context.Context,

     job *PublicationJob,

){



     // Transition to adapting

     job.Status = StatusAdapting

     po.stateManager.UpdateJob(ctx, job)
// Adapt content for each target platform

adaptedContent, err := po.adapterEngine.AdaptForPlatforms(

    ctx, job.ContentPackage, job.TargetPlatforms,

)

if err != nil {

    job.Status = StatusFailed

    po.stateManager.UpdateJob(ctx, job)

    return

}

job.AdaptedContent = adaptedContent



// Transition to publishing

job.Status = StatusPublishing

po.stateManager.UpdateJob(ctx, job)



// Publish to each platform in parallel

var wg sync.WaitGroup

results := make(chan PlatformResult, len(job.TargetPlatforms))



for _, target := range job.TargetPlatforms {

    wg.Add(1)

    go func(t PlatformTarget) {

      defer wg.Done()

      result := po.connectorManager.Publish(ctx, t.Platform, adaptedContent[t.Platform])

      results <- result

    }(target)
}



wg.Wait()

close(results)



// Process results

successCount := 0

failedPlatforms := []string{}



for result := range results {

    if result.Success {

        successCount++

    } else {

        failedPlatforms = append(failedPlatforms, result.Platform)

    }

}



// Determine final status

if successCount == len(job.TargetPlatforms) {

    job.Status = StatusPublished

    job.CompletedAt = timePtr(time.Now())

} else if successCount > 0 {

    job.Status = StatusPartialSuccess

    // Schedule retries for failed platforms

    po.scheduleRetries(ctx, job, failedPlatforms)

} else {
          if job.RetryCount < job.MaxRetries {

              job.Status = StatusRetrying

              job.RetryCount++

              po.scheduleRetry(ctx, job)

          } else {

              job.Status = StatusFailed

          }

      }



      po.stateManager.UpdateJob(ctx, job)

      po.eventBus.Publish(ctx, "distribution.job.completed", job)

}

```

  Update(ctx context.Context, platformPostID string, content *PlatformContent)
(*PublishResult, error)

3.2 Connector Implementations



```go

// Twitter/X Connector

type TwitterConnector struct {
    client     *twitter.Client

    rateLimiter *RateLimiter

    config     ConnectorConfig

}



func (tc *TwitterConnector) Publish(

    ctx context.Context,

    content *PlatformContent,

) (*PublishResult, error) {



    // Check rate limits

    if err := tc.rateLimiter.Wait(ctx); err != nil {

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("rate limit: %w", err)

    }



    // Build tweet

    tweet := &twitter.Tweet{

        Text: content.Text,

    }



    // Handle threading for longer content

    if len(content.Text) > 280 {

        tweet.Thread = tc.splitIntoThread(content.Text)

    }



    // Upload media first if present
    if len(content.MediaAttachments) > 0 {

        mediaIDs, err := tc.uploadMediaBatch(ctx, content.MediaAttachments)

        if err != nil {

             return nil, fmt.Errorf("media upload: %w", err)

        }

        tweet.MediaIDs = mediaIDs

    }



    // Publish tweet

    publishedTweet, err := tc.client.Tweets.Create(ctx, tweet)

    if err != nil {

        return tc.handleError(err)

    }



    return &PublishResult{

        Success:          true,

        PlatformPostID: publishedTweet.ID,

        PlatformURL: fmt.Sprintf("https://x.com/i/status/%s", publishedTweet.ID),

        PublishedAt: time.Now(),

    }, nil

}



// Facebook Connector

type FacebookConnector struct {

    client       *facebook.Client

    rateLimiter *RateLimiter
    config     ConnectorConfig

}



func (fc *FacebookConnector) Publish(

    ctx context.Context,

    content *PlatformContent,

) (*PublishResult, error) {



    if err := fc.rateLimiter.Wait(ctx); err != nil {

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("rate limit: %w", err)

    }



    // Determine post type

    postType := fc.determinePostType(content)



    switch postType {

    case "link_post":

        return fc.publishLinkPost(ctx, content)

    case "photo_post":

        return fc.publishPhotoPost(ctx, content)

    case "video_post":

        return fc.publishVideoPost(ctx, content)

    default:

        return fc.publishTextPost(ctx, content)

    }

}
// YouTube Connector

type YouTubeConnector struct {

    client        *youtube.Service

    rateLimiter *RateLimiter

    config        ConnectorConfig

}



func (yc *YouTubeConnector) Publish(

    ctx context.Context,

    content *PlatformContent,

) (*PublishResult, error) {



    if err := yc.rateLimiter.Wait(ctx); err != nil {

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("rate limit: %w", err)

    }



    // YouTube publishing requires video upload first

    video := &youtube.Video{

        Snippet: &youtube.VideoSnippet{

             Title:   content.Title,

             Description: content.Description,

             Tags:    content.Tags,

             CategoryId: content.CategoryID,

        },

        Status: &youtube.VideoStatus{
             PrivacyStatus: content.Privacy,

        },

    }



    // Upload video file

    call := yc.client.Videos.Insert([]string{"snippet", "status"}, video)

    call.Media(content.VideoFile)



    uploadedVideo, err := call.Do()

    if err != nil {

        return yc.handleError(err)

    }



    // Upload thumbnail if provided

    if content.Thumbnail != nil {

        yc.client.Thumbnails.Set(uploadedVideo.Id, content.Thumbnail).Do()

    }



    return &PublishResult{

        Success:       true,

        PlatformPostID: uploadedVideo.Id,

        PlatformURL: fmt.Sprintf("https://youtube.com/watch?v=%s", uploadedVideo.Id),

        PublishedAt: time.Now(),

    }, nil

}
