3.3 Connector Manager



```go

type ConnectorManager struct {

      connectors      map[string]PlatformConnector

      credentialStore *CredentialStore

      healthMonitor *HealthMonitor

      mu           sync.RWMutex

}



func (cm *ConnectorManager) RegisterConnector(

      platform string,

      connector PlatformConnector,

      config ConnectorConfig,

) error {

      cm.mu.Lock()

      defer cm.mu.Unlock()



      // Initialize connector

      if err := connector.Initialize(context.Background(), config); err != nil {

          return fmt.Errorf("initialize connector %s: %w", platform, err)

      }
    cm.connectors[platform] = connector



    // Start health monitoring

    cm.healthMonitor.StartMonitoring(platform, connector)



    return nil

}



func (cm *ConnectorManager) Publish(

    ctx context.Context,

    platform string,

    content *PlatformContent,

) PlatformResult {



    cm.mu.RLock()

    connector, exists := cm.connectors[platform]

    cm.mu.RUnlock()



    if !exists {

        return PlatformResult{

            Platform: platform,

            Success: false,

            Error: fmt.Errorf("no connector registered for platform: %s", platform),

        }

    }
// Check connector health

health, _ := connector.HealthCheck(ctx)

if health.Status != "HEALTHY" {

    return PlatformResult{

        Platform: platform,

        Success: false,

        Error: fmt.Errorf("connector unhealthy: %s", health.Message),

    }

}



// Publish with retry

result, err := connector.Publish(ctx, content)

if err != nil {

    return PlatformResult{

        Platform: platform,

        Success: false,

        Error: err,

    }

}



return PlatformResult{

    Platform:      platform,

    Success:      result.Success,

    PlatformPostID: result.PlatformPostID,

    PlatformURL: result.PlatformURL,
        PublishedAt: result.PublishedAt,

    }

}



func (cm *ConnectorManager) HotSwapConnector(

    ctx context.Context,

    platform string,

    newConnector PlatformConnector,

    config ConnectorConfig,

) error {

    cm.mu.Lock()

    defer cm.mu.Unlock()



    // Gracefully shutdown old connector

    if oldConnector, exists := cm.connectors[platform]; exists {

        oldConnector.Shutdown(ctx)

        cm.healthMonitor.StopMonitoring(platform)

    }



    // Initialize new connector

    if err := newConnector.Initialize(ctx, config); err != nil {

        return fmt.Errorf("initialize new connector: %w", err)

    }



    cm.connectors[platform] = newConnector

    cm.healthMonitor.StartMonitoring(platform, newConnector)
      return nil

}

type CredentialStore struct {

      vault *vault.Client

      cache *redis.Client

type TokenManager struct {

      store *CredentialStore

      refresher *TokenRefresher

}



func (tm *TokenManager) GetValidToken(

      ctx context.Context,

      platform string,

      tenantID string,

) (*PlatformCredentials, error) {



      // Try cache first

      cacheKey := fmt.Sprintf("token:%s:%s", platform, tenantID)
cached, err := tm.store.cache.Get(ctx, cacheKey).Result()

if err == nil {

    var creds PlatformCredentials

    json.Unmarshal([]byte(cached), &creds)



    // Check if still valid

    if creds.ExpiresAt == nil || time.Now().Before(*creds.ExpiresAt) {

        return &creds, nil

    }

}



// Retrieve from vault

creds, err := tm.store.vault.GetCredentials(ctx, platform, tenantID)

if err != nil {

    return nil, fmt.Errorf("vault retrieval: %w", err)

}



// Check if token needs refresh

if creds.ExpiresAt != nil && time.Now().After(*creds.ExpiresAt) {

    // Token expired, refresh

    newCreds, err := tm.refresher.RefreshToken(ctx, platform, creds)

    if err != nil {

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("token refresh: %w", err)

    }

    creds = newCreds
          // Store refreshed credentials

          tm.store.vault.StoreCredentials(ctx, platform, tenantID, creds)

      }



      // Cache with TTL

      ttl := 5 * time.Minute

      if creds.ExpiresAt != nil {

          ttl = time.Until(*creds.ExpiresAt) / 2

      }

      data, _ := json.Marshal(creds)

      tm.store.cache.Set(ctx, cacheKey, data, ttl)



      return creds, nil

}

func (cae *ContentAdaptationEngine) adaptForTwitter(

    content *ContentPackage,

    rules PlatformRules,

) *PlatformContent {



    adapted := &PlatformContent{

        Platform: "twitter",

    }



    // Twitter: 280 chars, thread for longer content

    headline := content.Headlines["social"]

    summary := content.Summaries["short"]

    link := content.CanonicalURL



    postText := fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s", headline, summary)



    if len(postText) <= 280 {

        adapted.Body = postText
    } else {

        // Split into thread

        adapted.Thread = cae.splitIntoThread(postText, 280)

        adapted.Body = adapted.Thread[0]

    }



    // Add link (Twitter shortens automatically)

    adapted.Body += "\n" + link



    return adapted

}



func (cae *ContentAdaptationEngine) adaptForLinkedIn(

    content *ContentPackage,

    rules PlatformRules,

) *PlatformContent {



    adapted := &PlatformContent{

        Platform: "linkedin",

    }



    // LinkedIn: professional tone, longer form, 3000 chars

    headline := content.Headlines["primary"]

    summary := content.Summaries["executive"]



    // First 3 lines are preview - make them count
    hook := cae.generateLinkedInHook(content)



    body := fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s\n\n%s\n\n%s\n\nRead more: %s",

        hook,

        headline,

        summary,

        content.KeyTakeaways,

        content.CanonicalURL,

    )



    // Truncate if needed

    if len(body) > 3000 {

        body = body[:2997] + "..."

    }



    adapted.Body = body

    adapted.Hashtags = cae.generateProfessionalHashtags(content, 3)



    return adapted

}

func (se *SchedulingEngine) scheduleOptimal(

    ctx context.Context,

    job *PublicationJob,

    config *ScheduleConfig,

) error {



    // Use AI to determine optimal publishing time

    optimalTime, err := se.calculateOptimalTime(ctx, job, config)

    if err != nil {

        return fmt.Errorf("optimal time calculation: %w", err)

    }



    job.ScheduledFor = &optimalTime

    job.Status = StatusScheduled



    // Schedule the job

    return se.queueManager.EnqueueAt(ctx, job, optimalTime)

}
func (se *SchedulingEngine) calculateOptimalTime(

  ctx context.Context,

  job *PublicationJob,

  config *ScheduleConfig,

) (time.Time, error) {



  // Consider multiple factors:

  // 1. Historical engagement data for similar content

  // 2. Platform-specific peak times

  // 3. Target audience timezone distribution

  // 4. Competing content schedule

  // 5. Content type and category



  factors := map[string]float64{

      "historical_engagement": 0.35,

      "platform_peak":       0.25,

      "audience_timezone":     0.20,

      "content_type":     0.10,

      "competition_avoidance": 0.10,

  }



  // Get audience timezone distribution

  audienceTZ := se.timezoneService.GetAudienceDistribution(ctx,
job.ContentPackage.TargetAudience)



  // Get platform peak times
    platformPeaks := se.getPlatformPeakTimes(job.TargetPlatforms)



    // Score each candidate time slot

    candidateTimes := se.generateCandidateTimes(audienceTZ, platformPeaks)



    var bestTime time.Time

    bestScore := 0.0



    for _, candidate := range candidateTimes {

        score := se.scoreTimeSlot(candidate, factors, job, audienceTZ, platformPeaks)

        if score > bestScore {

            bestScore = score

            bestTime = candidate

        }

    }



    return bestTime, nil

}



func (se *SchedulingEngine) scheduleCampaign(

    ctx context.Context,

    job *PublicationJob,

    config *ScheduleConfig,

) error {



    // Retrieve campaign definition
      campaign, err := se.calendarService.GetCampaign(ctx, config.CampaignID)

      if err != nil {

          return fmt.Errorf("campaign retrieval: %w", err)

      }



      // Validate campaign slot availability

      if !campaign.HasAvailableSlot(job.Priority) {

          return ErrCampaignSlotUnavailable

      }



      // Assign to campaign slot

      slot := campaign.AssignSlot(job)

      job.ScheduledFor = &slot.PublishTime

      job.Status = StatusScheduled



      // Register with campaign

      se.calendarService.RegisterCampaignContent(ctx, config.CampaignID, job.JobID)



      return se.queueManager.EnqueueAt(ctx, job, slot.PublishTime)

}

5.2 Queue Management



```go

type QueueManager struct {
    queues map[PublicationPriority]*PriorityQueue

    redis *redis.Client

}



type PriorityQueue struct {

    Name       string

    Priority PublicationPriority

    Jobs     chan *PublicationJob

}



func (qm *QueueManager) Enqueue(ctx context.Context, job *PublicationJob) error {

    queue := qm.queues[job.Priority]



    select {

    case queue.Jobs <- job:

        return nil

    case <-ctx.Done():

        return ctx.Err()

    default:

        // Queue full - store in Redis as overflow

        return qm.enqueueToRedis(ctx, job)

    }

}



func (qm *QueueManager) EnqueueAt(

    ctx context.Context,
    job *PublicationJob,

    publishTime time.Time,

) error {



    delay := time.Until(publishTime)

    if delay <= 0 {

        // Due now - enqueue immediately

        return qm.Enqueue(ctx, job)

    }



    // Store in Redis sorted set with score = publish time

    score := float64(publishTime.Unix())



    data, _ := json.Marshal(job)

    return qm.redis.ZAdd(ctx, "distribution:scheduled_jobs", &redis.Z{

        Score: score,

        Member: data,

    }).Err()

}



func (qm *QueueManager) ProcessScheduledJobs(ctx context.Context) {

    ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Second)

    defer ticker.Stop()



    for {

        select {
    case <-ticker.C:

      now := float64(time.Now().Unix())



      // Get all jobs scheduled for now or earlier

      jobs, err := qm.redis.ZRangeByScore(ctx, "distribution:scheduled_jobs",
&redis.ZRangeBy{

          Min: "0",

          Max: fmt.Sprintf("%f", now),

      }).Result()



      if err != nil {

          continue

      }



      for _, data := range jobs {

          var job PublicationJob

          json.Unmarshal([]byte(data), &job)



          // Enqueue for processing

          qm.Enqueue(ctx, &job)



          // Remove from scheduled set

          qm.redis.ZRem(ctx, "distribution:scheduled_jobs", data)

      }



    case <-ctx.Done():
              return

          }

      }

}

type ContinuousUpdateService struct {

      orchestrator *PublicationOrchestrator

      storyGraph StoryGraphClient

      eventBus       kafka.Producer

func (cus *ContinuousUpdateService) StreamUpdates(

    ctx context.Context,

    storyID string,

) error {



    // Subscribe to story updates from Story Graph

    updateChan, err := cus.storyGraph.WatchStoryUpdates(ctx, storyID)

    if err != nil {

        return fmt.Errorf("watch story updates: %w", err)

    }



    for update := range updateChan {

        // Process update

        job, err := cus.processUpdate(ctx, storyID, update)

        if err != nil {

            log.Error().Err(err).Str("story_id", storyID).Msg("Update processing failed")

            continue

        }



        // Publish update event

        cus.eventBus.Publish(ctx, "distribution.story.updated", job)

    }



    return nil

}
func (cus *ContinuousUpdateService) processUpdate(

  ctx context.Context,

  storyID string,

  update *StoryUpdate,

) (*PublicationJob, error) {



  // Get all published jobs for this story

  publishedJobs, err := cus.orchestrator.stateManager.GetPublishedJobs(ctx, storyID)

  if err != nil {

      return nil, fmt.Errorf("get published jobs: %w", err)

  }



  // Create update job

  updateJob := &PublicationJob{

      JobID:    uuid.NewV7().String(),

      StoryID: storyID,

      JobType: JobTypeUpdate,

      Priority: PriorityHigh,

      Status: StatusQueued,

      CreatedAt: time.Now(),

  }



  // For each published platform, create update

  for _, pubJob := range publishedJobs {

      for _, platformJob := range pubJob.PlatformJobs {
                if platformJob.Status == "PUBLISHED" {

                    updateJob.TargetPlatforms = append(updateJob.TargetPlatforms, PlatformTarget{

                         Platform: platformJob.Platform,

                         ConnectorID: platformJob.ConnectorID,

                    })

                }

           }

      }



      // Submit update

      return cus.orchestrator.SubmitJob(ctx, &SubmitPublicationJobRequest{

           ContentPackageID: update.ContentPackageID,

           Priority:          PriorityHigh,

           Targets:            updateJob.TargetPlatforms,

           Schedule: &PublicationSchedule{

                Immediate: &ImmediatePublish{},

           },

      })

}

type SyncEngine struct {

type SyncOperation struct {

    StoryID       string         `json:"story_id"`

    AffectedPlatforms []string        `json:"affected_platforms"`

    Status      SyncStatus         `json:"status"`

    CreatedAt      time.Time         `json:"created_at"`

    CompletedAt      *time.Time         `json:"completed_at"`

}



type SyncOperationType string

const (

    SyncTypeUpdate         SyncOperationType = "UPDATE"

    SyncTypeCorrection SyncOperationType = "CORRECTION"
    SyncTypeRetraction SyncOperationType = "RETRACTION"

    SyncTypeMediaReplace SyncOperationType = "MEDIA_REPLACE"

    SyncTypeHeadlineChange SyncOperationType = "HEADLINE_CHANGE"

)



type ContentChange struct {

    Field      string   `json:"field"`

    OldValue interface{} `json:"old_value"`

    NewValue interface{} `json:"new_value"`

    ChangeType string        `json:"change_type"` // ADD, MODIFY, DELETE

}



func (se *SyncEngine) SynchronizeStory(

    ctx context.Context,

    storyID string,

    newContent *ContentPackage,

) (*SyncOperation, error) {



    // 1. Get all published versions of this story

    publishedVersions, err := se.stateManager.GetPublishedVersions(ctx, storyID)

    if err != nil {

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("get published versions: %w", err)

    }



    // 2. Calculate diff between current published and new content

    currentContent := publishedVersions.GetLatestContent()
changes := se.diffCalculator.CalculateDiff(currentContent, newContent)



if len(changes) == 0 {

    return nil, nil // No changes needed

}



// 3. Determine sync operation type

opType := se.determineSyncType(changes)



// 4. Create sync operation

operation := &SyncOperation{

    OperationID:      uuid.NewV7().String(),

    StoryID:       storyID,

    OperationType:     opType,

    AffectedPlatforms: publishedVersions.GetPlatforms(),

    Changes:        changes,

    Status:        SyncStatusInProgress,

    CreatedAt:       time.Now(),

}



// 5. Execute sync for each platform

var wg sync.WaitGroup

results := make(chan PlatformSyncResult, len(operation.AffectedPlatforms))



for _, platform := range operation.AffectedPlatforms {

    wg.Add(1)
      go func(p string) {

          defer wg.Done()

      result := se.syncPlatform(ctx, p, publishedVersions.GetPlatformPostID(p), newContent,
changes)

          results <- result

      }(platform)

  }



  wg.Wait()

  close(results)



  // 6. Process results

  allSuccess := true

  for result := range results {

      if !result.Success {

          allSuccess = false

          log.Error().Str("platform", result.Platform).Err(result.Error).Msg("Sync failed")

      }

  }



  if allSuccess {

      operation.Status = SyncStatusCompleted

  } else {

      operation.Status = SyncStatusPartial

  }
      operation.CompletedAt = timePtr(time.Now())



      // 7. Save sync operation

      se.stateManager.SaveSyncOperation(ctx, operation)



      return operation, nil

}

```

type CorrectionEngine struct {

      stateManager *PublicationStateManager

      notificationSvc NotificationService

}
type CorrectionRequest struct {

    StoryID       string         `json:"story_id"`

    CorrectionType CorrectionType         `json:"correction_type"`

    Description    string         `json:"description"`

    Severity      CorrectionSeverity `json:"severity"`

    RequestedBy      string         `json:"requested_by"`

    RequestedAt      time.Time         `json:"requested_at"`

    AffectedContent []string          `json:"affected_content"` // Specific URLs/IDs

    CorrectedContent *ContentPackage `json:"corrected_content,omitempty"`

}



type CorrectionType string

const (

    CorrectionMinor        CorrectionType = "MINOR"      // Typo fix

    CorrectionSubstantive CorrectionType = "SUBSTANTIVE" // Factual error

    CorrectionRetraction CorrectionType = "RETRACTION" // Full retraction

    CorrectionTakedown CorrectionType = "TAKEDOWN" // Legal removal

    CorrectionUpdate CorrectionType = "UPDATE"            // New information

)



type CorrectionSeverity string

const (

    SeverityLow      CorrectionSeverity = "LOW"

    SeverityMedium CorrectionSeverity = "MEDIUM"

    SeverityHigh     CorrectionSeverity = "HIGH"

    SeverityCritical CorrectionSeverity = "CRITICAL"
)



func (ce *CorrectionEngine) IssueCorrection(

    ctx context.Context,

    request *CorrectionRequest,

) (*CorrectionResult, error) {



    result := &CorrectionResult{

        CorrectionID: uuid.NewV7().String(),

        StoryID:    request.StoryID,

        Type:      request.CorrectionType,

        Status:    CorrectionStatusInProgress,

        StartedAt: time.Now(),

    }



    switch request.CorrectionType {

    case CorrectionMinor, CorrectionSubstantive, CorrectionUpdate:

        // Update content with correction notice

        result = ce.processContentCorrection(ctx, request)



    case CorrectionRetraction:

        // Full retraction on all platforms

        result = ce.processRetraction(ctx, request)



    case CorrectionTakedown:

        // Legal takedown - remove from all platforms
        result = ce.processTakedown(ctx, request)

    }



    // Log correction

    ce.auditLogger.LogCorrection(ctx, result)



    // Notify stakeholders

    ce.notificationSvc.NotifyCorrection(ctx, result)



    return result, nil

}



func (ce *CorrectionEngine) processRetraction(

    ctx context.Context,

    request *CorrectionRequest,

) *CorrectionResult {



    // 1. Get all published instances

    published, _ := ce.stateManager.GetPublishedVersions(ctx, request.StoryID)



    // 2. Generate retraction notice

    retractionNotice := ce.generateRetractionNotice(request)



    // 3. Update all platforms

    for _, pub := range published.PlatformVersions {

        switch pub.Platform {
        case "web":

            // Update article with retraction banner and update metadata

            ce.updateWebWithRetraction(ctx, pub, retractionNotice)



        case "twitter", "facebook", "linkedin":

            // Post retraction notice (some platforms don't support editing)

            ce.postRetractionNotice(ctx, pub.Platform, retractionNotice, pub.PlatformPostID)



        case "youtube":

            // Update video description and title

            ce.updateYouTubeWithRetraction(ctx, pub, retractionNotice)

        }

    }



    // 4. Update Story Graph

    ce.syncEngine.UpdateStoryGraphWithRetraction(ctx, request.StoryID)



    return &CorrectionResult{

        CorrectionID: uuid.NewV7().String(),

        StoryID:      request.StoryID,

        Type:         CorrectionRetraction,

        Status:       CorrectionStatusCompleted,

        PlatformsUpdated: len(published.PlatformVersions),

        CompletedAt:      time.Now(),

    }

}
func (ce *CorrectionEngine) generateRetractionNotice(

      request *CorrectionRequest,

) *RetractionNotice {



      severityLabels := map[CorrectionSeverity]string{

          SeverityLow:     "Correction",

          SeverityMedium: "Correction",

          SeverityHigh:    "Significant Correction",

          SeverityCritical: "Retraction",

      }



      return &RetractionNotice{

          Title: fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", severityLabels[request.Severity], request.StoryHeadline),

          Body: request.Description,

          Date: time.Now(),

          Reason: string(request.CorrectionType),

          EditorNote: request.EditorNote,

      }

}

type DeliveryMonitor struct {

type DeliveryStatus struct {

    StoryID      string           `json:"story_id"`

    PlatformStatuses []PlatformDeliveryStatus `json:"platform_statuses"`

    StartedAt     time.Time           `json:"started_at"`

    CompletedAt      *time.Time          `json:"completed_at"`

    Duration      time.Duration         `json:"duration"`

    RetryCount      int            `json:"retry_count"`

}



type PlatformDeliveryStatus struct {

    Platform      string        `json:"platform"`

    Status       DeliveryStatusState `json:"status"`
     PlatformPostID string           `json:"platform_post_id,omitempty"`

     PlatformURL       string       `json:"platform_url,omitempty"`

     AttemptNumber int                `json:"attempt_number"`

     LastAttemptAt *time.Time           `json:"last_attempt_at"`

     NextRetryAt      *time.Time       `json:"next_retry_at,omitempty"`

     ErrorMessage string             `json:"error_message,omitempty"`

     ErrorCode        string       `json:"error_code,omitempty"`

     IsRetryable   bool            `json:"is_retryable"`

}



type DeliveryStatusState string

const (

     DeliveryQueued        DeliveryStatusState = "QUEUED"

     DeliveryPublishing DeliveryStatusState = "PUBLISHING"

     DeliveryPublished DeliveryStatusState = "PUBLISHED"

     DeliveryFailed      DeliveryStatusState = "FAILED"

     DeliveryRetrying DeliveryStatusState = "RETRYING"

     DeliveryCancelled DeliveryStatusState = "CANCELLED"

     DeliveryExpired      DeliveryStatusState = "EXPIRED"

     DeliveryAcknowledged DeliveryStatusState = "ACKNOWLEDGED"

)



func (dm *DeliveryMonitor) TrackDelivery(

     ctx context.Context,

     job *PublicationJob,

){
ticker := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Second)

defer ticker.Stop()



for {

    select {

    case <-ticker.C:

        status := dm.checkDeliveryStatus(ctx, job)

        dm.updateMetrics(status)



        // Check for stalled deliveries

        if dm.isStalled(status) {

            dm.alertManager.TriggerAlert(ctx, AlertStalledDelivery, status)

        }



        // Check if all platforms complete

        if status.OverallStatus == DeliveryPublished ||

            status.OverallStatus == DeliveryFailed {

            dm.finalizeDelivery(ctx, status)

            return

        }



    case <-ctx.Done():

        return

    }

}
}



func (dm *DeliveryMonitor) checkDeliveryStatus(

    ctx context.Context,

    job *PublicationJob,

) *DeliveryStatus {



    status := &DeliveryStatus{

        JobID:       job.JobID,

        StoryID:        job.StoryID,

        StartedAt:       job.CreatedAt,

        RetryCount: job.RetryCount,

    }



    successCount := 0



    for _, platformJob := range job.PlatformJobs {

        platformStatus := PlatformDeliveryStatus{

            Platform:     platformJob.Platform,

            AttemptNumber: platformJob.AttemptCount,

        }



        // Check actual platform status

        if platformJob.PlatformPostID != "" {

       postStatus, err := dm.connectorManager.GetStatus(ctx, platformJob.Platform,
platformJob.PlatformPostID)
        if err == nil {

            platformStatus.PlatformPostID = platformJob.PlatformPostID

            platformStatus.PlatformURL = postStatus.URL

            platformStatus.Status = DeliveryPublished

            successCount++

        } else {

            platformStatus.Status = DeliveryFailed

            platformStatus.ErrorMessage = err.Error()

        }

    } else {

        platformStatus.Status = DeliveryPublishing

    }



    status.PlatformStatuses = append(status.PlatformStatuses, platformStatus)

}



// Determine overall status

totalPlatforms := len(job.TargetPlatforms)

if successCount == totalPlatforms {

    status.OverallStatus = DeliveryPublished

    now := time.Now()

    status.CompletedAt = &now

    status.Duration = now.Sub(status.StartedAt)

} else if successCount > 0 {

    status.OverallStatus = DeliveryPublishing

} else if job.RetryCount >= job.MaxRetries {
          status.OverallStatus = DeliveryFailed

          now := time.Now()

          status.CompletedAt = &now

      } else {

          status.OverallStatus = DeliveryPublishing

      }



      return status

}

func (ais *AnalyticsIntegrationService) CollectPostMetrics(

     ctx context.Context,

     publishedJobs []*PublishedJob,

){



     for _, job := range publishedJobs {

       for _, platformJob := range job.PlatformJobs {

         if platformJob.PlatformPostID == "" {

             continue

         }
            client, exists := ais.platformAnalytics[platformJob.Platform]

            if !exists {

                continue

            }



            // Fetch metrics

            metrics, err := client.GetPostMetrics(ctx, platformJob.PlatformPostID)

            if err != nil {

                log.Error().Err(err).Str("platform", platformJob.Platform).Msg("Metrics collection
failed")

                continue

            }



            metrics.StoryID = job.StoryID



            // Store metrics

            ais.metricsStore.StorePostMetrics(ctx, metrics)



            // Publish metrics event

            ais.eventBus.Publish(ctx, "analytics.post.metrics", metrics)

        }

    }

}



func (ais *AnalyticsIntegrationService) StreamRealtimeMetrics(
     ctx context.Context,

){



     for platform, client := range ais.platformAnalytics {

         go func(p string, c PlatformAnalyticsClient) {

           stream, err := c.StreamRealtimeMetrics(ctx)

           if err != nil {

               return

           }



           for metric := range stream {

               metric.Platform = p

               ais.metricsStore.StoreRealtimeMetric(ctx, metric)

               ais.eventBus.Publish(ctx, "analytics.realtime.metric", metric)

           }

         }(platform, client)

     }

}



// Feedback loop to AI optimization

func (ais *AnalyticsIntegrationService) GenerateOptimizationFeedback(

     ctx context.Context,

     timeframe time.Duration,

     // Aggregate metrics across all platforms
metrics, err := ais.metricsStore.GetAggregatedMetrics(ctx, timeframe)

if err != nil {

    return nil, err

}



feedback := &OptimizationFeedback{

    GeneratedAt: time.Now(),

    Timeframe: timeframe,

}



// Best performing content types

feedback.BestContentTypes = ais.analyzeContentTypePerformance(metrics)



// Best publishing times

feedback.OptimalPublishTimes = ais.analyzeTimingPerformance(metrics)



// Best platforms by engagement

feedback.PlatformPerformance = ais.analyzePlatformPerformance(metrics)



// Headline optimization insights

feedback.HeadlineInsights = ais.analyzeHeadlinePerformance(metrics)



// Hashtag effectiveness

feedback.HashtagEffectiveness = ais.analyzeHashtagPerformance(metrics)



// Publish feedback event for AI systems
      ais.eventBus.Publish(ctx, "analytics.optimization.feedback", feedback)



      return feedback, nil

}

PART XII — ENTERPRISE ADRs



```markdown

## ADR-DIST-001: Connector Plugin Architecture

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Platform connectors as independent, hot-swappable plugins.

**Rationale:** Platforms change APIs frequently. Plugin architecture enables independent
deployment and scaling.

**Consequences:** Plugin management overhead, but essential for agility.



## ADR-DIST-002: Event-Sourced Publication State

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Event sourcing for all publication state with Kafka as event store.

**Rationale:** Complete audit trail, replay capability, real-time monitoring.

**Consequences:** Additional storage, but essential for compliance and recovery.



## ADR-DIST-003: Priority-Based Publication Queues

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Four priority queues with preemptive scheduling for breaking news.
**Rationale:** Breaking news and corrections must never wait behind bulk content.

**Consequences:** Complex queue management, but essential for news platform.



## ADR-DIST-004: Idempotent Publication

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Content hashing for idempotent publication to prevent duplicates.

**Rationale:** Network failures cause retries; must prevent duplicate posts.

**Consequences:** Hash computation overhead, negligible.



## ADR-DIST-005: Breaking News Separate Path

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Dedicated breaking news delivery path with independent infrastructure.

**Rationale:** Breaking news SLAs (30s) require isolated resources from standard content.

**Consequences:** Infrastructure cost, but essential for news platform credibility.



## ADR-DIST-006: Platform Policy as Code

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Platform policies and formatting rules stored as versioned configuration.

**Rationale:** Platform rules change frequently; configuration updates don't require
deployments.

**Consequences:** Configuration management overhead.



## ADR-DIST-007: Analytics Feedback Loop

**Status:** Accepted

**Decision:** Real-time analytics feedback to AI systems for content optimization.

**Rationale:** Continuous improvement of content performance requires closed-loop
feedback.
**Consequences:** Data pipeline complexity but significant engagement improvements.

```

ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORDS (ADR)



ADR-ANA-001: Unified Analytics Data Lake



Decision: All analytics events flow into a unified data lake (S3 + Apache Iceberg) before being
processed into specialized stores (ClickHouse for real-time, PostgreSQL for operational, Neo4j
for relationship analytics).

Rationale: Single source of truth prevents data discrepancies. Iceberg provides schema
evolution and time travel. Specialized stores optimize for different query patterns.

Alternatives Considered: Direct write to multiple stores (rejected — data consistency issues);
single store for everything (rejected — performance trade-offs).



ADR-ANA-002: Real-Time + Batch Analytics Dual Path



Decision: Implement dual processing paths: sub-second real-time stream for dashboards/alerts,
hourly batch for deep analytics and ML training.
Rationale: Breaking news requires instant metrics; deep analysis requires historical context.
Separate paths optimize each use case.

Consequences: Additional infrastructure complexity but necessary for news platform
requirements.



ADR-ANA-003: Closed-Loop AI Optimization



Decision: All content performance data flows back to AI agents via a structured feedback
protocol, enabling continuous model improvement without manual intervention.

Rationale: AI-generated content quality improves only with feedback. Manual feedback doesn't
scale to 500,000+ stories/day.

Consequences: Requires careful feedback validation to prevent reward hacking.



ADR-ANA-004: Platform-Agnostic Analytics Abstraction



Decision: Normalize all platform metrics into a unified schema regardless of source platform
differences.

Rationale: Cross-platform comparison requires consistent metrics. Platform APIs change;
abstraction protects downstream systems.

Consequences: Some platform-specific nuance lost, but essential for unified intelligence.

1.2 Publishing Pipeline State Machine



```go

type PublishingState string



const (

      StateContentReceived PublishingState = "CONTENT_RECEIVED"

      StateValidating       PublishingState = "VALIDATING"

      StateAdapting         PublishingState = "ADAPTING"

      StateAdaptationComplete PublishingState = "ADAPTATION_COMPLETE"

      StateQueued           PublishingState = "QUEUED"

      StatePublishing       PublishingState = "PUBLISHING"

      StatePartiallyPublished PublishingState = "PARTIALLY_PUBLISHED"

      StatePublished        PublishingState = "PUBLISHED"

      StateFailed        PublishingState = "FAILED"

      StateRetrying         PublishingState = "RETRYING"

      StateDeadLettered       PublishingState = "DEAD_LETTERED"

      StateRetracting       PublishingState = "RETRACTING"

      StateRetracted        PublishingState = "RETRACTED"
    StateUpdating        PublishingState = "UPDATING"

    StateArchived        PublishingState = "ARCHIVED"

)



type PublishingStateMachine struct {

    job        *PublishingJob

    currentState PublishingState

    stateHistory []StateTransition

    eventBus       EventBus

}



type StateTransition struct {

    FromState PublishingState `json:"from_state"`

    ToState    PublishingState `json:"to_state"`

    Event      PublishingEvent `json:"event"`

    Timestamp time.Time         `json:"timestamp"`

    Metadata json.RawMessage `json:"metadata"`

}



type PublishingEvent string



const (

    EventContentSubmitted       PublishingEvent = "CONTENT_SUBMITTED"

    EventValidationPassed     PublishingEvent = "VALIDATION_PASSED"

    EventValidationFailed     PublishingEvent = "VALIDATION_FAILED"

    EventAdaptationStarted PublishingEvent = "ADAPTATION_STARTED"
    EventAdaptationComplete PublishingEvent = "ADAPTATION_COMPLETE"

    EventAdaptationFailed      PublishingEvent = "ADAPTATION_FAILED"

    EventQueuedForPublishing PublishingEvent = "QUEUED_FOR_PUBLISHING"

    EventPublishingStarted PublishingEvent = "PUBLISHING_STARTED"

    EventPlatformSuccess       PublishingEvent = "PLATFORM_SUCCESS"

    EventPlatformFailed      PublishingEvent = "PLATFORM_FAILED"

    EventAllPlatformsComplete PublishingEvent = "ALL_PLATFORMS_COMPLETE"

    EventPartialSuccess      PublishingEvent = "PARTIAL_SUCCESS"

    EventRetryScheduled        PublishingEvent = "RETRY_SCHEDULED"

    EventRetryExhausted        PublishingEvent = "RETRY_EXHAUSTED"

    EventRetractionStarted PublishingEvent = "RETRACTION_STARTED"

    EventRetractionComplete PublishingEvent = "RETRACTION_COMPLETE"

    EventUpdateReceived        PublishingEvent = "UPDATE_RECEIVED"

    EventUpdatePublished        PublishingEvent = "UPDATE_PUBLISHED"

    EventArchived          PublishingEvent = "ARCHIVED"

)



func (sm *PublishingStateMachine) Transition(event PublishingEvent, metadata interface{})
error {

    sm.mu.Lock()

    defer sm.mu.Unlock()



    validStates, exists := sm.transitions[sm.currentState]

    if !exists {

        return fmt.Errorf("no transitions defined from state: %s", sm.currentState)

    }
nextState, valid := validStates[event]

if !valid {

    return fmt.Errorf("invalid transition: %s -> %s", sm.currentState, event)

}



// Record transition

transition := StateTransition{

    FromState: sm.currentState,

    ToState: nextState,

    Event:    event,

    Timestamp: time.Now(),

}



if metadata != nil {

    transition.Metadata, _ = json.Marshal(metadata)

}



sm.stateHistory = append(sm.stateHistory, transition)

sm.currentState = nextState



// Persist state change as event

sm.eventBus.Publish("distribution.state.changed", StateChangedEvent{

    JobID:     sm.job.JobID,

    Transition: transition,

    CurrentState: nextState,
      })



      // Handle side effects based on new state

      sm.handleStateEntry(nextState, event)



      return nil

}



func (sm *PublishingStateMachine) handleStateEntry(state PublishingState, event
PublishingEvent) {

      switch state {

      case StateAdapting:

           go sm.startAdaptation()

      case StatePublishing:

           go sm.startPlatformPublishing()

      case StateRetrying:

           go sm.scheduleRetry()

      case StateRetracting:

           go sm.startRetraction()

      case StateFailed:

           sm.sendFailureAlert()

      case StateDeadLettered:

           sm.sendDLQAlert()

      }

}

type RetryPolicy struct {

      MaxRetries     int          `json:"max_retries"`

      BaseDelay     time.Duration      `json:"base_delay"`

      MaxDelay       time.Duration     `json:"max_delay"`

      BackoffMultiplier float64       `json:"backoff_multiplier"`

      RetryableErrors []string       `json:"retryable_errors"`

      NonRetryableErrors []string      `json:"non_retryable_errors"`

}
var PublishingRetryPolicy = map[PublicationPriority]RetryPolicy{

  PriorityCritical: {

       MaxRetries:      5,

       BaseDelay:       1 * time.Second,

       MaxDelay:        30 * time.Second,

       BackoffMultiplier: 2.0,

       RetryableErrors: []string{"RATE_LIMITED", "NETWORK_ERROR", "TIMEOUT", "5XX"},

    NonRetryableErrors: []string{"AUTH_FAILED", "INVALID_CONTENT", "PLATFORM_BANNED",
"4XX"},

  },

  PriorityHigh: {

       MaxRetries:      3,

       BaseDelay:       5 * time.Second,

       MaxDelay:        60 * time.Second,

       BackoffMultiplier: 2.0,

       RetryableErrors: []string{"RATE_LIMITED", "NETWORK_ERROR", "TIMEOUT", "5XX"},

    NonRetryableErrors: []string{"AUTH_FAILED", "INVALID_CONTENT",
"PLATFORM_BANNED"},

  },

  PriorityMedium: {

       MaxRetries:      3,

       BaseDelay:       10 * time.Second,

       MaxDelay:        120 * time.Second,

       BackoffMultiplier: 2.0,

       RetryableErrors: []string{"RATE_LIMITED", "NETWORK_ERROR", "5XX"},
    NonRetryableErrors: []string{"AUTH_FAILED", "INVALID_CONTENT", "PLATFORM_BANNED",
"4XX"},

    },

    PriorityLow: {

         MaxRetries:      2,

         BaseDelay:      30 * time.Second,

         MaxDelay:       300 * time.Second,

         BackoffMultiplier: 2.0,

         RetryableErrors: []string{"RATE_LIMITED", "5XX"},

    NonRetryableErrors: []string{"AUTH_FAILED", "INVALID_CONTENT", "PLATFORM_BANNED",
"4XX", "TIMEOUT"},

    },

}



type RetryManager struct {

    policy     RetryPolicy

    dlq       *DeadLetterQueue

    metrics *MetricsStore

}



func (rm *RetryManager) ExecuteWithRetry(

    ctx context.Context,

    operation func(context.Context) error,

    jobID string,

) error {



    var lastErr error
delay := rm.policy.BaseDelay



for attempt := 0; attempt <= rm.policy.MaxRetries; attempt++ {

  if attempt > 0 {

      // Wait before retry

      select {

      case <-time.After(delay):

          delay = time.Duration(float64(delay) * rm.policy.BackoffMultiplier)

          if delay > rm.policy.MaxDelay {

              delay = rm.policy.MaxDelay

          }

      case <-ctx.Done():

          return ctx.Err()

      }



      rm.metrics.IncrementRetry(jobID)

  }



  err := operation(ctx)

  if err == nil {

      return nil

  }



  lastErr = err



  // Classify error
        errorType := rm.classifyError(err)



        if rm.isNonRetryable(errorType) {

            rm.sendToDLQ(jobID, err, attempt)

            return fmt.Errorf("non-retryable error: %w", err)

        }



        if !rm.isRetryable(errorType) {

            rm.sendToDLQ(jobID, err, attempt)

            return fmt.Errorf("unclassified error: %w", err)

        }

    }



    // Max retries exceeded

    rm.sendToDLQ(jobID, lastErr, rm.policy.MaxRetries)

    return fmt.Errorf("max retries (%d) exceeded: %w", rm.policy.MaxRetries, lastErr)

}



type DeadLetterQueue struct {

    kafka       kafka.Producer

    topic       string

    alertManager *AlertManager

}



func (dlq *DeadLetterQueue) Send(

    ctx context.Context,
  jobID string,

  err error,

  attemptCount int,

  jobData interface{},

) error {



  dlqMessage := &DLQMessage{

      MessageID: uuid.NewV7().String(),

      JobID:         jobID,

      Error:      err.Error(),

      AttemptCount: attemptCount,

      JobData:        jobData,

      SentToDLQAt: time.Now(),

      RequiresHuman: true,

  }



  data, _ := json.Marshal(dlqMessage)



  if err := dlq.kafka.Produce(ctx, &kafka.Message{

      Topic: dlq.topic,

      Key: []byte(jobID),

      Value: data,

  }); err != nil {

      return fmt.Errorf("DLQ write failed: %w", err)

  }
      // Alert on DLQ entries

      dlq.alertManager.TriggerAlert(ctx, AlertDLQMessage, map[string]interface{}{

           "job_id": jobID,

           "error":   err.Error(),

           "attempts": attemptCount,

      })



      return nil

}

2.2 Media Upload Pipeline



```go

type MediaUploadPipeline struct {

      processors []MediaProcessor

      cdnUploader *CDNUploader

      transcoder *MediaTranscoder
    optimizer    *MediaOptimizer

}



type MediaProcessor interface {

    Process(ctx context.Context, media *MediaAsset) (*ProcessedMedia, error)

    SupportedFormats() []string

}



type MediaUploadJob struct {

    JobID       string         `json:"job_id"`

    ContentID      string        `json:"content_id"`

    OriginalMedia *MediaAsset           `json:"original_media"`

    Variants     []MediaVariant      `json:"variants"`

    Status       MediaUploadStatus `json:"status"`

    Progress      float64        `json:"progress"`

    Results      []MediaUploadResult `json:"results"`

}



type MediaVariant struct {

    Platform      string        `json:"platform"`

    Format       string         `json:"format"`

    Dimensions         ImageDimension    `json:"dimensions,omitempty"`

    Quality      int          `json:"quality"`      // 1-100

    CompressionLevel int            `json:"compression_level"`

}
type MediaUploadResult struct {

    Platform       string `json:"platform"`

    Variant       string `json:"variant"`

    URL           string `json:"url"`

    CDNURL          string `json:"cdn_url"`

    FileSize      int64         `json:"file_size"`

    Format         string `json:"format"`

    Width          int         `json:"width"`

    Height        int          `json:"height"`

    UploadedAt time.Time `json:"uploaded_at"`

    PlatformID string `json:"platform_id,omitempty"`

}



func (mup *MediaUploadPipeline) ProcessMedia(

    ctx context.Context,

    media *MediaAsset,

    platforms []string,

) (*MediaUploadJob, error) {



    job := &MediaUploadJob{

        JobID:           uuid.NewV7().String(),

        ContentID:         media.ContentID,

        OriginalMedia: media,

        Status:          MediaUploadStatusProcessing,

        Progress:         0,

    }
// 1. Determine required variants for each platform

for _, platform := range platforms {

    rules := GetPlatformRules(platform)

    variants := mup.determineVariants(media, rules)

    job.Variants = append(job.Variants, variants...)

}



totalVariants := len(job.Variants)



// 2. Process variants in parallel

var mu sync.Mutex

var wg sync.WaitGroup

results := make(chan MediaUploadResult, totalVariants)

semaphore := make(chan struct{}, 5) // Limit concurrent uploads



for _, variant := range job.Variants {

    wg.Add(1)

    go func(v MediaVariant) {

      defer wg.Done()

      semaphore <- struct{}{}

      defer func() { <-semaphore }()



      // Process variant

      processed, err := mup.processVariant(ctx, media, v)

      if err != nil {
    log.Error().Err(err).Str("platform", v.Platform).Msg("Variant processing failed")

    return

}



// Upload to CDN

cdnURL, err := mup.cdnUploader.Upload(ctx, processed)

if err != nil {

    log.Error().Err(err).Msg("CDN upload failed")

    return

}



result := MediaUploadResult{

    Platform: v.Platform,

    Variant: fmt.Sprintf("%dx%d", v.Dimensions.Width, v.Dimensions.Height),

    URL:      cdnURL,

    CDNURL:        cdnURL,

    FileSize: processed.Size,

    Format:       processed.Format,

    Width:        processed.Width,

    Height:       processed.Height,

    UploadedAt: time.Now(),

}



results <- result



mu.Lock()
            job.Progress = float64(len(job.Results)+1) / float64(totalVariants)

            mu.Unlock()

          }(variant)

      }



      wg.Wait()

      close(results)



      for result := range results {

          job.Results = append(job.Results, result)

      }



      job.Status = MediaUploadStatusComplete

      job.Progress = 1.0



      return job, nil

}

3.3 Real-Time Analytics Processing



```go

func (rtae *RealTimeAnalyticsEngine) ProcessEvent(

    ctx context.Context,

    event *AnalyticsEvent,
) error {



  // 1. Write to ClickHouse

  if err := rtae.clickhouse.Insert(ctx, "analytics_events", event); err != nil {

      return fmt.Errorf("clickhouse insert: %w", err)

  }



  // 2. Update real-time counters in Redis

  pipeline := rtae.redis.Pipeline()



  // Increment total counters

  pipeline.HIncrBy(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("story:%s:metrics", event.StoryID),

      fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s", event.Platform, event.EventType), 1)



  // Update velocity counter (sliding window)

  now := time.Now().Unix()

  windowKey := fmt.Sprintf("story:%s:velocity:%d", event.StoryID, now/60) // Per-minute
window

  pipeline.Incr(ctx, windowKey)

  pipeline.Expire(ctx, windowKey, 5*time.Minute)



  // Update trending score

  pipeline.ZIncrBy(ctx, "trending:stories", 1, event.StoryID)



  if _, err := pipeline.Exec(ctx); err != nil {

      return fmt.Errorf("redis update: %w", err)
    }



    // 3. Check alerts

    rtae.checkAlerts(ctx, event)



    return nil

}



func (rtae *RealTimeAnalyticsEngine) GetStoryMetrics(

    ctx context.Context,

    storyID string,

) (*StoryMetrics, error) {



    // Get real-time metrics from Redis

    redisData, _ := rtae.redis.HGetAll(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("story:%s:metrics", storyID)).Result()



    // Get detailed metrics from ClickHouse

    query := `

        SELECT

          platform,

          event_type,

          count() as count

        FROM analytics_events

        WHERE story_id = ?

        AND event_timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

        GROUP BY platform, event_type
`



rows, err := rtae.clickhouse.Query(ctx, query, storyID)

if err != nil {

    return nil, err

}

defer rows.Close()



metrics := &StoryMetrics{

    StoryID:        storyID,

    PlatformMetrics: make(map[string]*PlatformStoryMetrics),

}



for rows.Next() {

    var platform, eventType string

    var count int64

    rows.Scan(&platform, &eventType, &count)



    if metrics.PlatformMetrics[platform] == nil {

        metrics.PlatformMetrics[platform] = &PlatformStoryMetrics{

            Platform: platform,

        }

    }



    pm := metrics.PlatformMetrics[platform]

    switch eventType {
      case "IMPRESSION":

          pm.Impressions = count

      case "CLICK":

          pm.Clicks = count

      case "ENGAGEMENT":

          pm.Engagements = count

      case "SHARE":

          pm.Shares = count

      case "COMMENT":

          pm.Comments = count

      case "LIKE":

          pm.Likes = count

      case "SAVE":

          pm.Saves = count

      }



      metrics.TotalImpressions += count

  }



  // Calculate derived metrics

  if metrics.TotalImpressions > 0 {

      metrics.CTR = float64(metrics.TotalClicks) / float64(metrics.TotalImpressions) * 100

     metrics.EngagementRate = float64(metrics.TotalEngagements) /
float64(metrics.TotalImpressions) * 100

  }
      // Calculate velocity

      metrics.CurrentVelocity = rtae.calculateVelocity(ctx, storyID)



      // Check if trending

      metrics.IsTrending = metrics.CurrentVelocity > 10.0 // 10+ engagements/min

      metrics.ViralProbability = rtae.calculateViralProbability(ctx, metrics)



      return metrics, nil

}

class BatchAnalyticsEngine:

      """

      Spark-based batch analytics for deep analysis and ML training.

      """



      def __init__(self, spark_session, data_lake_path, feature_store):

        self.spark = spark_session

        self.data_lake = data_lake_path

        self.feature_store = feature_store



      def run_daily_analytics(self, date: str) -> DailyAnalyticsReport:

        """
Generate comprehensive daily analytics report.

"""



# Load day's events

events = self.spark.read.format("iceberg") \

  .load(f"{self.data_lake}/analytics_events") \

  .filter(f"date(event_timestamp) = '{date}'")



report = DailyAnalyticsReport(date=date)



# 1. Story Performance Analysis

report.story_performance = self.analyze_story_performance(events)



# 2. Platform Comparison

report.platform_comparison = self.analyze_platforms(events)



# 3. Audience Analysis

report.audience_insights = self.analyze_audience(events)



# 4. AI Performance Analysis

report.ai_performance = self.analyze_ai_performance(events)



# 5. Content Type Analysis

report.content_type_analysis = self.analyze_content_types(events)



# 6. Time-of-Day Analysis
    report.timing_analysis = self.analyze_posting_times(events)



    # 7. Viral Content Analysis

    report.viral_analysis = self.analyze_viral_content(events)



    # 8. Revenue Attribution

    report.revenue_attribution = self.analyze_revenue(events)



    return report



  def analyze_story_performance(self, events) -> StoryPerformanceReport:

    """

    Analyze performance of all stories.

    """



    return events.groupBy("story_id", "content_type", "content_category") \

      .agg(

          F.countDistinct("user_id").alias("unique_readers"),

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "IMPRESSION",
1).otherwise(0)).alias("impressions"),

          F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "CLICK", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("clicks"),

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "ENGAGEMENT",
1).otherwise(0)).alias("engagements"),

          F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "SHARE", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("shares"),

          F.avg("read_depth").alias("avg_read_depth"),

          F.avg("time_on_page").alias("avg_time_on_page"),

          F.sum("revenue_impact").alias("total_revenue"),
      )\

      .withColumn("ctr", F.col("clicks") / F.col("impressions") * 100) \

      .withColumn("engagement_rate", F.col("engagements") / F.col("impressions") * 100) \

      .orderBy(F.col("engagements").desc())



  def analyze_viral_content(self, events) -> ViralContentReport:

    """

    Identify viral content patterns.

    """



    # Define viral threshold (top 1% by engagement velocity)

    velocity_window = Window.partitionBy("story_id").orderBy("event_timestamp")



    viral_candidates = events \

      .withColumn("engagement_count",

        F.when(F.col("event_type").isin(["LIKE", "SHARE", "COMMENT", "RETWEET"]),
1).otherwise(0)) \

      .withColumn("hour", F.window("event_timestamp", "1 hour")) \

      .groupBy("story_id", "hour") \

      .agg(F.sum("engagement_count").alias("hourly_engagements")) \

      .withColumn("velocity", F.col("hourly_engagements") / 3600)



    # Identify viral patterns

    viral_stories = viral_candidates \

      .groupBy("story_id") \

      .agg(
              F.max("velocity").alias("peak_velocity"),

              F.avg("velocity").alias("avg_velocity"),

              F.sum("hourly_engagements").alias("total_engagements"),

          )\

          .filter(F.col("peak_velocity") > 100) # 100+ engagements/hour



      # Analyze common characteristics

      viral_characteristics = events \

          .filter(F.col("story_id").isin([r.story_id for r in viral_stories.collect()])) \

          .groupBy("content_type", "content_category", "content_archetype") \

          .agg(

              F.countDistinct("story_id").alias("viral_stories"),

              F.avg("read_depth").alias("avg_read_depth"),

          )



      return ViralContentReport(

          viral_stories=viral_stories,

          characteristics=viral_characteristics,

      )

type RecommendationEngine struct {

    neo4j        neo4j.Driver

    redis        *redis.Client

    clickhouse *clickhouse.Client

    modelRegistry *ModelRegistry

}



type ContentRecommendation struct {

    StoryID         string         `json:"story_id"`

    Title         string         `json:"title"`

    Score          float64         `json:"score"`

    RecommendationType string               `json:"recommendation_type"`

    Reason           string        `json:"reason"`

    PersonalizationFactors []string        `json:"personalization_factors"`

}



func (re *RecommendationEngine) GetRecommendations(

    ctx context.Context,

    userID string,

    context RecommendationContext,

    limit int,

) ([]*ContentRecommendation, error) {
// 1. Get user profile

userProfile, err := re.getUserProfile(ctx, userID)

if err != nil {

    // Fall back to non-personalized recommendations

    return re.getTrendingRecommendations(ctx, limit)

}



// 2. Multi-strategy recommendation blending

strategies := []RecommendationStrategy{

    &CollaborativeFiltering{weight: 0.35},

    &ContentBasedFiltering{weight: 0.30},

    &TrendingBoost{weight: 0.15},

    &FreshnessBoost{weight: 0.10},

    &ExplorationDiversification{weight: 0.10},

}



// 3. Generate candidates from each strategy

var allCandidates []*ContentRecommendation

var mu sync.Mutex

var wg sync.WaitGroup



for _, strategy := range strategies {

    wg.Add(1)

    go func(s RecommendationStrategy) {

      defer wg.Done()
      candidates, err := s.GetCandidates(ctx, userProfile, context, limit*2)

      if err != nil {

          return

      }



      // Apply strategy weight

      for _, c := range candidates {

          c.Score *= s.GetWeight()

      }



      mu.Lock()

      allCandidates = append(allCandidates, candidates...)

      mu.Unlock()

    }(strategy)

}



wg.Wait()



// 4. Merge and deduplicate

merged := re.mergeAndDeduplicate(allCandidates)



// 5. Re-rank with ML model

ranked, err := re.rankWithML(ctx, userProfile, merged, context)

if err != nil {

    // Fall back to score-based ranking
        sort.Slice(merged, func(i, j int) bool {

             return merged[i].Score > merged[j].Score

        })

        ranked = merged

    }



    // 6. Apply diversity and freshness constraints

    diversified := re.ensureDiversity(ranked)



    // 7. Apply business rules

    filtered := re.applyBusinessRules(ctx, diversified, userID)



    if len(filtered) > limit {

        filtered = filtered[:limit]

    }



    return filtered, nil

}



func (re *RecommendationEngine) rankWithML(

    ctx context.Context,

    userProfile *UserProfile,

    candidates []*ContentRecommendation,

    context RecommendationContext,

) ([]*ContentRecommendation, error) {
      // Load ranking model

      model, err := re.modelRegistry.LoadModel("content_ranking_v3")

      if err != nil {

           return nil, err

      }



      // Build feature vectors for each candidate

      features := make([]float64, len(candidates))



      for i, candidate := range candidates {

           featureVector := re.buildFeatureVector(userProfile, candidate, context)

           score, _ := model.Predict(featureVector)

           candidate.Score = score

      }



      // Sort by predicted score

      sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {

           return candidates[i].Score > candidates[j].Score

      })



      return candidates, nil

}

func (aoe *AIOptimizationEngine) GenerateOptimizationSignals(

    // 2. Publishing Time Optimization

    }
// 3. Content Structure Optimization

if err == nil {

    signals = append(signals, structureSignals...)

}



// 4. Platform Adaptation Optimization

if err == nil {

    signals = append(signals, platformSignals...)

}



// 5. Image/Thumbnail Optimization

imageSignals, err := aoe.optimizeImages(ctx, timeWindow)

if err == nil {

    signals = append(signals, imageSignals...)

// 6. Hashtag Optimization

if err == nil {

    signals = append(signals, hashtagSignals...)

}



// Publish signals to AI agents

func (aoe *AIOptimizationEngine) optimizeHeadlines(

    ctx context.Context,

    timeWindow time.Duration,

) ([]*OptimizationSignal, error) {



    // Analyze headline performance patterns

    query := `

        SELECT

          headline_pattern,

          count() as usage_count,

          avg(ctr) as avg_ctr,

          avg(engagement_rate) as avg_engagement

        FROM headline_performance

        WHERE published_at >= now() - INTERVAL ?

        GROUP BY headline_pattern

        HAVING usage_count > 100

        ORDER BY avg_ctr DESC

    `



    results, _ := aoe.clickhouse.Query(ctx, query, timeWindow)
      signals := []*OptimizationSignal{}



      // Identify top-performing patterns

      for _, result := range results {

          if result.AvgCTR > baselineCTR * 1.2 {

              signals = append(signals, &OptimizationSignal{

                   SignalType: OptHeadlineGeneration,

                   Target:      "headline_generation_prompt",

                   RecommendedChange: fmt.Sprintf("Increase usage of pattern: %s", result.Pattern),

                   Confidence: min(result.AvgCTR/baselineCTR, 1.0),

                   Evidence: []EvidencePoint{

                        {Metric: "avg_ctr", Value: result.AvgCTR, Baseline: baselineCTR},

                        {Metric: "usage_count", Value: float64(result.UsageCount)},

                   },

              })

          }

      }



      return signals, nil

}

5.3 A/B Testing & Multi-Armed Bandit



```go
type ExperimentEngine struct {

type ContentExperiment struct {

    ExperimentID string               `json:"experiment_id"`

    Name          string         `json:"name"`

    Status       ExperimentStatus        `json:"status"`

    Variants      []ExperimentVariant     `json:"variants"`

    TrafficSplit map[string]float64      `json:"traffic_split"`

    Metric        string        `json:"primary_metric"`

    StartTime      time.Time          `json:"start_time"`

    EndTime        *time.Time           `json:"end_time"`

    Results       *ExperimentResults      `json:"results,omitempty"`

}



type ExperimentVariant struct {

    VariantID      string        `json:"variant_id"`

    Name          string         `json:"name"`

    Parameters      map[string]interface{} `json:"parameters"`

    Impressions     int64           `json:"impressions"`

    Conversions     int64           `json:"conversions"`

    ConversionRate float64              `json:"conversion_rate"`

    ConfidenceInterval ConfidenceInterval `json:"confidence_interval"`
    IsWinner      bool            `json:"is_winner"`

    ImprovementOverBaseline float64         `json:"improvement_over_baseline"`

}



type BanditSolver struct {

    algorithm string // THOMPSON_SAMPLING, UCB, EPSILON_GREEDY

}



func (bs *BanditSolver) SelectVariant(

    ctx context.Context,

    experiment *ContentExperiment,

) (*ExperimentVariant, error) {



    switch bs.algorithm {

    case "THOMPSON_SAMPLING":

        return bs.thompsonSampling(experiment)

    case "UCB":

        return bs.upperConfidenceBound(experiment)

    case "EPSILON_GREEDY":

        return bs.epsilonGreedy(experiment, 0.1)

    default:

        return bs.thompsonSampling(experiment)

    }

}



func (bs *BanditSolver) thompsonSampling(
    experiment *ContentExperiment,

) (*ExperimentVariant, error) {



    var bestVariant *ExperimentVariant

    var bestSample float64



    for i := range experiment.Variants {

        variant := &experiment.Variants[i]



        // Beta distribution sampling

        alpha := float64(variant.Conversions + 1)

        beta := float64(variant.Impressions - variant.Conversions + 1)



        sample := sampleBetaDistribution(alpha, beta)



        if sample > bestSample {

            bestSample = sample

            bestVariant = variant

        }

    }



    return bestVariant, nil

}



func (ee *ExperimentEngine) AnalyzeExperiment(

    ctx context.Context,
  experimentID string,

) (*ExperimentResults, error) {



  experiment, err := ee.experimentStore.Get(ctx, experimentID)

  if err != nil {

      return nil, err

  }



  // Calculate statistics for each variant

  for i := range experiment.Variants {

      variant := &experiment.Variants[i]



      // Calculate conversion rate

      if variant.Impressions > 0 {

          variant.ConversionRate = float64(variant.Conversions) / float64(variant.Impressions)

      }



      // Calculate confidence interval (Wilson score)

      variant.ConfidenceInterval = calculateWilsonCI(

          variant.Conversions, variant.Impressions, 0.95,

      )

  }



  // Find winner using statistical test

  baseline := &experiment.Variants[0] // First variant is control

  for i := 1; i < len(experiment.Variants); i++ {
          variant := &experiment.Variants[i]



          // Perform chi-squared test

          pValue := chiSquaredTest(

              variant.Conversions, variant.Impressions,

              baseline.Conversions, baseline.Impressions,

          )



          if pValue < 0.05 && variant.ConversionRate > baseline.ConversionRate {

              variant.IsWinner = true

              variant.ImprovementOverBaseline =

                (variant.ConversionRate - baseline.ConversionRate) / baseline.ConversionRate * 100

          }

      }



      results := &ExperimentResults{

          ExperimentID: experimentID,

          Variants:    experiment.Variants,

          DeclaredWinner: findWinner(experiment.Variants),

          StatisticalPower: calculateStatisticalPower(experiment),

          Recommendation: generateRecommendation(experiment),

      }



      return results, nil

}

type StoryMonitor struct {

type StoryHealthStatus struct {

    StoryID        string        `json:"story_id"`

    PublishedAt      time.Time        `json:"published_at"`

    TimeSincePublish time.Duration        `json:"time_since_publish"`



    // Health Indicators

    HealthScore       float64       `json:"health_score"`     // 0-100

    Status        StoryHealthState `json:"status"`



    // Engagement

    CurrentEngagement float64            `json:"current_engagement"` // per minute
    EngagementTrend string                 `json:"engagement_trend"`         // RISING, STABLE, FALLING

    PeakEngagement         float64          `json:"peak_engagement"`

    TimeToPeak         time.Duration        `json:"time_to_peak"`



    // Virality

    ViralScore       float64          `json:"viral_score"`        // 0-100

    IsViral        bool            `json:"is_viral"`

    ShareVelocity      float64          `json:"share_velocity"`



    // Decay

    DecayRate         float64          `json:"decay_rate"`         // % engagement decline/hour

    EstimatedLifespan time.Duration            `json:"estimated_lifespan"`

    IsDecaying       bool             `json:"is_decaying"`



    // Opportunities

    RepublishOpportunity bool               `json:"republish_opportunity"`

    UpdateRecommended bool                     `json:"update_recommended"`

    RefreshReason         string         `json:"refresh_reason,omitempty"`



    // Alerts

    ActiveAlerts     []StoryAlert        `json:"active_alerts"`

}



type StoryHealthState string

const (

    HealthRising     StoryHealthState = "RISING"
    HealthPeaking StoryHealthState = "PEAKING"

    HealthStable      StoryHealthState = "STABLE"

    HealthDecaying StoryHealthState = "DECAYING"

    HealthDormant StoryHealthState = "DORMANT"

    HealthResurging StoryHealthState = "RESURGING"

)



func (sm *StoryMonitor) MonitorStoryHealth(

    ctx context.Context,

    storyID string,

) (*StoryHealthStatus, error) {



    status := &StoryHealthStatus{

        StoryID: storyID,

    }



    // Get current metrics

    metrics, err := sm.getCurrentMetrics(ctx, storyID)

    if err != nil {

        return nil, err

    }



    status.CurrentEngagement = metrics.EngagementVelocity

    status.ShareVelocity = metrics.ShareVelocity



    // Calculate health score
status.HealthScore = sm.calculateHealthScore(metrics)



// Determine engagement trend

status.EngagementTrend = sm.determineTrend(ctx, storyID)



// Calculate viral score

status.ViralScore = sm.calculateViralScore(ctx, metrics)

status.IsViral = status.ViralScore > 75



// Calculate decay

status.DecayRate, status.EstimatedLifespan = sm.calculateDecay(ctx, storyID)

status.IsDecaying = status.DecayRate > 5.0 // 5%+ decline per hour



// Determine health state

status.Status = sm.determineHealthState(status)



// Check for opportunities

if status.Status == HealthDormant && sm.hasEvergreenPotential(ctx, storyID) {

    status.RepublishOpportunity = true

    status.RefreshReason = "Evergreen content with historical engagement"

}



if status.Status == HealthDecaying && status.HealthScore > 40 {

    status.UpdateRecommended = true

    status.RefreshReason = "Content decaying but still has engagement potential"

}
    // Check alerts

    status.ActiveAlerts = sm.checkAlerts(ctx, status)



    return status, nil

}



func (sm *StoryMonitor) calculateViralScore(

    ctx context.Context,

    metrics *StoryMetrics,

) float64 {



    // Viral score based on:

    // 1. Share velocity relative to baseline

    // 2. Engagement velocity acceleration

    // 3. External referrer diversity

    // 4. Comment sentiment velocity



    shareScore := normalizeScore(metrics.ShareVelocity, 0, 100)

    accelerationScore := normalizeScore(metrics.EngagementAcceleration, -10, 50)

    referrerScore := normalizeScore(float64(metrics.UniqueReferrers), 0, 50)

    sentimentScore := normalizeScore(metrics.PositiveSentimentRatio, 0, 1) * 100



    weights := map[string]float64{

      "share": 0.35,

      "acceleration": 0.30,
        "referrer": 0.20,

        "sentiment": 0.15,

    }



    viralScore := shareScore*weights["share"] +

        accelerationScore*weights["acceleration"] +

        referrerScore*weights["referrer"] +

        sentimentScore*weights["sentiment"]



    return math.Min(100, viralScore)

}



func (sm *StoryMonitor) hasEvergreenPotential(

    ctx context.Context,

    storyID string,

) bool {



    // Check if story has characteristics of evergreen content

    query := `

        SELECT

          content_category,

          content_type,

          avg(engagement_rate) as historical_avg

        FROM analytics_events

        WHERE story_id = ?

        AND event_timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
          GROUP BY content_category, content_type

      `



      result, _ := sm.clickhouse.Query(ctx, query, storyID)



      // Evergreen categories

      evergreenCategories := []string{

          "EXPLAINER", "HOW_TO", "REFERENCE", "HISTORY",

          "SCIENCE", "TECHNOLOGY_EXPLAINED",

      }



      for _, cat := range evergreenCategories {

          if strings.Contains(result.Category, cat) {

              return true

          }

      }



      return false

}

```go

type ViralityDetector struct {

      clickhouse *clickhouse.Client
    redis      *redis.Client

    alertEngine *AlertEngine

    eventBus kafka.Producer

}



type ViralityAlert struct {

    AlertID       string         `json:"alert_id"`

    StoryID       string         `json:"story_id"`

    AlertType      ViralityAlertType `json:"alert_type"`

    Severity      string         `json:"severity"`

    CurrentMetrics *StoryMetrics          `json:"current_metrics"`

    ThresholdExceeded float64            `json:"threshold_exceeded"`

    RecommendedAction string              `json:"recommended_action"`

    CreatedAt       time.Time        `json:"created_at"`

}



type ViralityAlertType string

const (

    AlertGoingViral        ViralityAlertType = "GOING_VIRAL"

    AlertPeakReached         ViralityAlertType = "PEAK_REACHED"

    AlertEngagementDrop ViralityAlertType = "ENGAGEMENT_DROP"

    AlertNegativeViral ViralityAlertType = "NEGATIVE_VIRAL"

    AlertCompetitorResponse ViralityAlertType = "COMPETITOR_RESPONSE"

)



func (vd *ViralityDetector) MonitorForVirality(
     ctx context.Context,

){



     ticker := time.NewTicker(30 * time.Second)

     defer ticker.Stop()



     for {

       select {

       case <-ticker.C:

             // Check all active stories for viral patterns

             stories := vd.getActiveStories(ctx)



             for _, story := range stories {

                 metrics := vd.getMetrics(ctx, story.StoryID)



                 // Check viral thresholds

                 if metrics.ViralScore > 80 && !story.ViralAlertSent {

                     vd.sendViralAlert(ctx, story, metrics)

                 }



                 // Check for negative viral patterns

                 if metrics.NegativeSentimentRatio > 0.3 && metrics.EngagementVelocity > 50 {

                     vd.sendNegativeViralAlert(ctx, story, metrics)

                 }

             }
         case <-ctx.Done():

             return

         }

     }

}



func (vd *ViralityDetector) sendViralAlert(

     ctx context.Context,

     story *ActiveStory,

     metrics *StoryMetrics,

){



     alert := &ViralityAlert{

         AlertID: uuid.NewV7().String(),

         StoryID: story.StoryID,

         AlertType: AlertGoingViral,

         Severity: "HIGH",

         CurrentMetrics: metrics,

         CreatedAt: time.Now(),

     }



     // Determine recommended action

     if metrics.EngagementVelocity > 100 {

    alert.RecommendedAction = "BOOST_DISTRIBUTION - Content is going viral, increase
promotion"

     } else {
     alert.RecommendedAction = "MONITOR - Content showing viral potential, prepare
distribution boost"

      }



      // Send alert

      vd.alertEngine.TriggerAlert(ctx, "VIRALITY_DETECTED", alert)



      // Publish event

      vd.eventBus.Publish(ctx, "monitoring.virality.detected", alert)

}

type DisasterRecoveryPlan struct {

      rto time.Duration // Recovery Time Objective

}



var AnalyticsDR = DisasterRecoveryPlan{

      rpo: 5 * time.Minute, // Max 5 minutes of data loss

      rto: 15 * time.Minute, // Recovery within 15 minutes

}



var RecoveryProcedures = map[string]string{

      "clickhouse_failure": `

        1. Promote replica to primary

        2. Re-route traffic via DNS

        3. Replay Kafka events from last checkpoint

        4. Validate data integrity

        5. Notify stakeholders
      `,

      "redis_cluster_failure": `

           1. Failover to replica cluster

           2. Rebuild cache from ClickHouse

           3. Resume normal operations

      `,

      "kafka_cluster_failure": `

           1. Switch producers to backup cluster

           2. Resume consumer from last committed offset

           3. Monitor for message loss

      `,

}

PART IX — ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORDS



```markdown

## ADR-ANA-001: Unified Analytics Data Lake

**Decision:** All events → S3/Iceberg → Specialized stores

**Rationale:** Single source of truth, schema evolution, time travel

**Trade-offs:** Additional storage layer, but prevents data discrepancies



## ADR-ANA-002: Real-Time + Batch Dual Path

**Decision:** Separate real-time (ClickHouse) and batch (Spark) processing
**Rationale:** Different latency requirements for dashboards vs ML training

**Trade-offs:** Infrastructure complexity, but optimal for each use case



## ADR-ANA-003: Closed-Loop AI Optimization

**Decision:** Automated performance feedback to AI agents

**Rationale:** Manual feedback doesn't scale; continuous improvement required

**Trade-offs:** Risk of reward hacking; mitigated by human oversight



## ADR-ANA-004: Platform-Agnostic Analytics

**Decision:** Normalize all platform metrics to unified schema

**Rationale:** Cross-platform comparison, API abstraction

**Trade-offs:** Some platform nuance lost, but essential for unified view



## ADR-ANA-005: Redis for Real-Time, ClickHouse for Analytics

**Decision:** Redis for sub-second counters, ClickHouse for analytical queries

**Rationale:** Different data access patterns require different stores

**Trade-offs:** Two systems to maintain, but optimal performance



## ADR-ANA-006: Thompson Sampling for Multi-Armed Bandit

**Decision:** Use Thompson Sampling for A/B test optimization

**Rationale:** Better exploration-exploitation balance than epsilon-greedy

**Trade-offs:** Slightly more complex implementation, but better convergence



## ADR-ANA-007: Event Sourcing for Experiment Tracking

**Decision:** All experiment events stored as immutable event stream

**Rationale:** Complete audit trail, replay capability, prevents data manipulation
**Trade-offs:** Storage overhead, but essential for experiment validity

```

ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORDS (ADR)



ADR-OPS-001: Multi-Region Active-Active Deployment



Decision: Deploy Agbofa Nexus AI across three AWS regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-
1) in active-active configuration with global traffic management via Route 53 latency-based
routing.

Rationale: Autonomous newsroom requires 99.99% availability. Multi-region active-active
eliminates single-region failure risk and provides data sovereignty for regional compliance.

Alternatives Considered: Active-passive (rejected — failover latency unacceptable for breaking
news); single-region multi-AZ (rejected — insufficient for global audience).

Consequences: Higher infrastructure cost, data replication complexity, but essential for platform
reliability targets.



ADR-OPS-002: Istio Ambient Mesh for Service Communication



Decision: Use Istio Ambient Mesh (sidecar-less mode) for service-to-service communication,
replacing traditional sidecar proxies.

Rationale: Reduces resource overhead by 40-60% compared to sidecar model. Ambient mesh
provides zero-trust networking without per-pod sidecar injection.
Alternatives Considered: Traditional Istio sidecars (rejected — resource overhead); Linkerd
(rejected — fewer enterprise features); no mesh (rejected — security requirements).

Consequences: Requires Kubernetes 1.29+, newer technology but significant resource savings.



ADR-OPS-003: GitOps with Flux CD



Decision: Use Flux CD for GitOps-based continuous delivery, with all infrastructure and
application configs stored in Git.

Rationale: GitOps provides audit trail, rollback capability, and disaster recovery through Git. Flux
CD is CNCF-graduated with strong Kubernetes integration.

Alternatives Considered: ArgoCD (evaluated — equivalent; Flux chosen for tighter integration
with our Terraform workflow); traditional CI/CD push (rejected — lacks GitOps benefits).

Consequences: Requires Git discipline, but provides complete deployment auditability.



ADR-OPS-004: Tiered Storage with Automatic Data Lifecycle



Decision: Implement automatic data tiering: Kafka (7 days hot) → S3 Standard (90 days warm)
→ S3 Glacier (7 years cold) with automatic lifecycle policies.

Rationale: News platform generates 50TB+ daily. Cost-effective storage requires automatic
tiering based on access patterns and compliance requirements.

Consequences: Complex lifecycle policies, but 60-70% storage cost reduction.

2.2 Progressive Delivery Strategy



```yaml

# Argo Rollouts Configuration for Canary Deployments

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1

kind: Rollout

metadata:

 name: content-factory-service

 namespace: content-factory

spec:

 replicas: 10

 strategy:

      canary:

       # Canary steps

       steps:

        - setWeight: 5   # 5% traffic to canary

        - pause:

          duration: 5m # Wait 5 minutes

        - analysis:

          templates:

           - templateName: error-rate-check

           - templateName: latency-check
 - setWeight: 25 # 25% traffic

 - pause:

   duration: 10m

 - analysis:

   templates:

    - templateName: error-rate-check

 - setWeight: 50 # 50% traffic

 - pause:

   duration: 15m

 - setWeight: 100 # Full rollout



# Auto-promotion/rollback based on analysis

autoPromotionEnabled: true

autoPromotionSeconds: 600



# Anti-affinity for canary pods

antiAffinity:

 requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:

  - labelSelector:

    matchExpressions:

      - key: app

       operator: In

       values:

        - content-factory-service

   topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
---

# Analysis Template for Automated Validation

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1

kind: AnalysisTemplate

metadata:

 name: error-rate-check

 namespace: content-factory

spec:

 metrics:

  - name: error-rate

      interval: 1m

      count: 5

      successCondition: result[0] < 0.01 # Error rate < 1%

      failureCondition: result[0] >= 0.05 # Error rate >= 5%

      failureLimit: 2

      provider:

       prometheus:

        address: http://prometheus.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:9090

        query: |

         sum(rate(http_requests_total{

          namespace="content-factory",

          status_code=~"5.."

         }[5m])) /

         sum(rate(http_requests_total{

          namespace="content-factory"

         }[5m]))
---

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1

kind: AnalysisTemplate

metadata:

 name: latency-check

 namespace: content-factory

spec:

 metrics:

      - name: p99-latency

       interval: 1m

       count: 5

       successCondition: result[0] < 2 # p99 < 2 seconds

       failureCondition: result[0] >= 5 # p99 >= 5 seconds

       provider:

        prometheus:

         address: http://prometheus.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:9090

         query: |

          histogram_quantile(0.99,

           rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{

            namespace="content-factory"

           }[5m]))

```



2.3 Security Scanning Pipeline
```yaml

# CI Security Scanning

security_scanning:

 stages:

  pre_commit:

   - tool: pre-commit

    checks:

     - trailing-whitespace

     - end-of-file-fixer

     - detect-private-key

     - detect-aws-credentials



  pull_request:

   - tool: trufflehog

    scan: secrets

    severity: HIGH,CRITICAL



   - tool: semgrep

    scan: sast

    ruleset: p/default

    severity: ERROR,WARNING



   - tool: dependency-review

    scan: dependencies

    fail_on: CRITICAL
merge_to_main:

 - tool: trivy

  scan: container_image

  severity: CRITICAL,HIGH

  ignore_unfixed: false



 - tool: syft

  action: generate_sbom

  format: spdx-json



 - tool: cosign

  action: sign_image

  key: "${COSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY}"



 - tool: grype

  scan: vulnerability

  fail_on: CRITICAL



scheduled:

 - tool: trivy

  scan: kubernetes_cluster

  schedule: "0 6 * * *"



 - tool: kube-bench

  scan: cis_benchmark

  schedule: "0 7 * * *"
       - tool: kube-hunter

        scan: penetration

        schedule: "0 2 * * 0" # Weekly



# Image Signing Policy

image_signing:

 provider: cosign

 key_management: AWS KMS

 policy:

      require_signature: true

      require_sbom: true

      allowed_signer_identities:

       - "agbofa-ci@agbofa.com"



 verification:

      enabled: true

      mode: ENFORCE # Block unsigned images

```
